title: Hoenderloo
short_description: During this short walking route, you will discover the Veluwe.
long_description: This stretch of the Veluwe, like all the others, is beautiful. You will find beautiful forests and occasional fens. The walk is about 9 kilometres long, making it perfect for a Sunday afternoon. The Veluwe is the largest nature reserve in the Netherlands.

title: Hiking around Cassel in the heart of Flanders
short_description: Cassel, the ancient Gallo-Roman capital, is the highest point (176m) of this tour with its rich Flemish heritage: glazed tile houses, estaminets, hedgerows, chapels...
long_description: Route around Kassel.

title: Dahlet Qorrot Hiking Trail
short_description: Leisurely, panoramic circular walk in the surroundings of the typical Gozitan village of In-Nadur with a swim in Dahlet Qorrot Bay.
long_description: Our hike takes us to the eastern part of the island of Gozo. On the way through the typical landscapes of Malta we discover villages, coasts and bays. We start on a high plateau on which the village of In-Nadur is situated and which offers a special view over the coast. We enjoy another breathtaking view from the Ta' Sopu watchtower. This was built as early as 1667 and was intended to protect the east coast with its exposed position. In the meantime, the tower is open to tourists.

title: Hirschtal/Asang near Heidenheim
short_description: This medium tour runs through the two valleys Hirsch- and Wiesental.
long_description:
From Friedrich-Degeler-Platz we walk north along Marienstraße and Karlstraße, then cross the tracks over the pedestrian bridge and walk through Brenzpark. The Brenzpark recreation area was formerly the Landesgartenschau grounds. Past the sun and time path - a combination of sundial, celestial globe, planetary path, zodiac and time path - the route continues to Schnaitheim with the landmark of the district - the Schnaitheim mill.
In Schnaitheim we first cross the Brenz and then the railway tracks. Now the Steigstraße leads us up to the car park at the Hirschhalde quarry, where the circular trail begins. At the sign "Waldweg gesperrt" (forest path closed) on the right, we walk towards the barrier and continue straight ahead to the quarry. At the beginning of the 18th century, oolite (sedimentary rock) was quarried here. As we continue, we come to an open space with a fireplace. At the end of the open space we follow the footpath into the forest, after about 50 m we go left down a steep footpath to the hairpin bend of a gravel path, where we keep to the right and follow the Hirschhaldeweg almost to the Schnaitheim ski lift. Shortly before, however, we turn right and after 200 m turn left along the edge of the forest, always straight ahead through the meadow valley to an oak tree at the end of the valley. Here we go left up the hill to a gravel path, which we cross, walk again on grassy path for a bit to the next gravel path and turn right into it. We always stay on the path, cross a junction and keep following the path. At the top of the hill, turn left at a crossroads to the ski lift viewpoint. Back on the gravel path, we follow it to the Hirschhalde-Steinbruch car park, from where we return to Friedrich-Degerler-Platz along the same route as the outward walk. In the Brenzpark we can enjoy some refreshments in the beer garden.

title: गिरनार हिल ट्रैक
short_description: गुजरात के जूनागढ़ जिले में स्थित गिरनार एक प्राचीन धार्मिक केंद्र और पवित्र तीर्थ है। गिरनार की हरी भरी पहाड़ियों पर सैकड़ों हिंदू और जैन मंदिर हैं, जहां हर साल हजारों तीर्थयात्री आते हैं।
long_description:
लगभग 3700 फीट की ऊंचाई पर स्थित, गिरनार की पहाड़ियाँ जैन धर्म के सबसे महत्वपूर्ण शाश्वत तीर्थों में से एक है। गिरनार का प्राचीन नाम रैवतगिरी या उज्जयंतगिरी था और यहीं 22वें तीर्थंकर भगवान नेमिनाथ ने निर्वाण प्राप्त किया था। यह भी मान्यता है की आगे आने वाले 24 तीर्थंकर भी भविष्य में यहीं निर्वाण प्राप्त करेंगे। 
गिरनार पर्वत आज गिरनार वन्यजीव अभयारण्य क्षेत्र के अंतर्गत आता है। इसमें हिन्दू और जैन धर्म के 866 मंदिर है इसलिए यह एक तीर्थयात्रा मार्ग की श्रेणी के अंदर आता है।  हालाँकि यह बात गौर करने वाली है की गिरनार ट्रैक दुसरे पदयात्रा मार्गों से थोड़ा अलग है क्योंकि यह पूरी तरह से एक सीढ़ी वाला रास्ता है। इस मार्ग में 3800 सीढ़ियाँ हैं जिनको चढ़कर विभिन्न मुख्य मंदिरों तक पहुंचा जा सकता है।   
गिरनार पर्वत आज गिरनार वन्यजीव अभयारण्य क्षेत्र के अंतर्गत आता है। इसमें हिन्दू और जैन धर्म के 866 मंदिर है इसलिए यह एक तीर्थयात्रा मार्ग की श्रेणी के अंदर आता है।  हालाँकि यह बात गौर करने वाली है की गिरनार ट्रैक दुसरे पदयात्रा मार्गों से थोड़ा अलग है क्योंकि यह पूरी तरह से एक सीढ़ी वाला रास्ता है। इस मार्ग में 3800 सीढ़ियाँ हैं जिनको चढ़कर विभिन्न मुख्य मंदिरों तक पहुंचा जा सकता है।
गिरनार ट्रैक का आरंभ बिंदु जूनागढ़ शहर के केंद्र से 4 किलोमीटर दूर स्थित गिरनार तलहटी है हालाँकि इसके बिलकुल पास स्थित भावनाथ महादेव मंदिर भी ट्रैक शुरू करने का अच्छा लैंडमार्क है। मार्ग सीढ़ीदार और चढ़ाई वाला है। हरियाली से भरे हुए विशाल जूनागढ़ वन्यजीव अभयारण्य के एकदम बीचोंबीच में होने की वजह से हवा ताज़ी और साफ़ है। रास्ते में कुछ दुकानें और टॉयलेट भी हैं। साल 2000 से एक रोपवे/केबल-कार सेवा शुरू की गयी है जो पर्यटकों के बीच बहुत लोकप्रिय हो गयी है। चाहे पैदल चल कर जाएँ या फिर रोपवे से दोनों में ही बहुत आनंद मिलता है।

title: Olympic Park Embankment, Sochi
short_description: The promenade by the Olympic Park was born with the parks themselves in mind. And as the Olympic Games ended with the medals gone with the athletes, the sea of the promenade remained in its permanent place unchanged.
long_description: The waterfront of the Olympic Village is located in Adler (Sochi). It begins in Verkhneimertinskaya Bay and ends in Nizhneimertinskaya Bay. It is also called Nizhneimertinskaya embankment. The length of the embankment is slightly more than 7 km. You can stroll along the Black Sea without hurrying and you won't even notice that 2 hours are flying by. That is exactly the time you need to see the Olympic coastline. During the walk you will discover all the sites which were broadcasted during the recent Olympic Games in 2014. And now you can look beyond the sea of the Black Sea and combine the journey with a discussion about the architecture of the fancy buildings and their patrons. Incidentally, one can get carried away on a walking tour and stop off in Abkhazia. The Olympic Village borders with the Republic of Abkhazia, which has treated Sochi's tourists warmly for centuries.

title: Duck Egg Trail
short_description: The most famous and longest trail in the Juquery State Park, which holds the last remaining cerrado vegetation in São Paulo and offers wonderful views from the top of the Ovo da Pata hill.
long_description:
With just over 13 kilômeters, the round trip toé the Ovo da Pata hill that has 942 meters altitude and allows the enjoy the panoramic view of the neighboring cities, the Valley of Juquery River, the Serra da Cantareira and the Jaraguá State Park.
The Juquery State Park was created in June 1993 with the purpose of preserving the áMananciais areas of the Cantareira System. A long time ago, the site used to house the Juquery Psychiatric Hospital, designed by Ramos Azevedo and founded by Franco da Rocha in 1895. The place still maintains the structure of its former building, being possible to see it in many points of the trails.

title: Hiking through the Ländle - circular trail from Bietigheim-Bissingen
short_description: Immerse yourself in the Swabian Ländle. Vineyards, half-timbered houses and lively nature.
long_description: A beautiful circular walk from the old town of Bietigheim-Bissingen via the smaller, quaint villages of Löchgau and Besigheim. We start our tour in Bietigheim-Bissingen. The historic old town is famous for its beautiful town hall and the Hornmoldhaus right next to it. Here we can also see the Metter flowing into the Enz. However, our route takes us through Bietigheim's upper forest via the small town of Löchgau to Besigheim. In all the towns we can see the historic architecture in the half-timbered houses, a well-known feature of very old towns in the region. Particularly exciting is the old town wall of Besigheim, which we will see on our tour. Likewise, the path leads us several times through the vineyards, over some beautiful vantage points and through lovely, bright forest paths back to Bietigheim-Bissingen.

title: The Edinburgh Seven Summits Challenge
short_description: This route connects Edinburgh's seven hills and offers stunning panoramic views of the city from all angles. A classic challenge for walkers and runners alike this route is a great way to see the best of the city and explore areas on and off the beaten track.
long_description:
The seven summits are often tackled in one push, but can just as easily be split up and modified to suit your needs. Completionsits may consider ascending both West and East Craiglockhart Hills. The former is technically higher, while the latter is generally the one included on most peoples route including in the offical Seven Hills race!
If you want to learn more about the hill race the offical event can be found here -  http://www.seven-hills.org.uk/default.asp The 2022 winner completed the circuit in an unbelievable 1hr and 35 minutes. I would recommend a much more leisurely pace and would put aside a whole day to take in the views and enjoy plenty of refuelling stops along the route.
Most people start and finish on Calton Hill which offers arguably Edinburgh's most iconic view framing the Dugald Stewart Monument, The Balmoral, The Scott Monument and Edinburgh Castle in one beautiful frame. 
It is worth noting that I have made a modification to the 'classic' route to avoid West Princes Street Gardens as there have been some access issues here in the past, but is worth checking on the day.

title: Hiking to Peșteana Marsh (Bottomless Lake)
short_description: The trail leading from the Peșteana village to the homonymous marsh is an easy path that climbs through a deciduous forest and reaches a wide plateau. From here,  you have one of the most beautiful panoramic views over the crest of the Retezat Mountains.
long_description:
The nature trail set up by the team at the Țara Hațegului Geopark includes several information panels and hiking signs. The boards educate briefly on the area's relief, the species of butterflies swarming around, and the highlight of this trail - the round-leaved sundew which is found in the marsh.
On the trail, you can see sheep tracks, a sign that the shepherds were grazing their flocks on the plateau near the marsh.
On the hill, at the end of the trail, there are two gazebos where you can climb. There are benches for resting and panels describing the mountains in the distance.
The probability of seeing the spectacle of nature in winter is lower, so come visit outside of the cold season!

title: On the highest peak of the Allgäu Alps - Nebelhorn
short_description: There are at least three ways to climb the Nebelhorn (2224 m) which is the highest peak in the Bavarian Alps and the Alps of the Allgäu region. This hike is the more difficult route, although not the longest, and the difficulty comes from the difference in level.
long_description:
The route starts at the second station of the Nebelhornbahn cable car from Obsersdorf, the most important town at the foot of these mountains.
The first section of the route descends significantly, and then the trail climbs steadily up the valley. The scenery is reminiscent of the Transfăgărășan valley - walls with grooves and green patches, jagged ridges beyond which you can see other high passes hidden among the clouds and the small town that lies at the foot of the mountain.
The forest is rough but well contoured, with faint markings. Still, there's no getting lost. In summer, you can admire flowers and playful butterflies throughout. As you climb, more and more of the mountainous peaks of the Alps reveal themselves, all the way to Austria.
Due to the altitude, the air stays cool even in high temperatures, so an extra layer never hurts.

title: Crossing the Tâmpa Mountain (Valea Cetății - the Old City Center)
short_description: An easy trek, from one side of the Tâmpa to the other. It is an alternative to the classic ascent/descent to or from the top. It can also be done with children, and dogs will surely enjoy this long walk.
long_description:
The walk starts at the end of the Răcădău (Valea Cetății) neighborhood, following the road to „La iepure”, where it suddenly turns onto a marked path.
In winter, the snow is beaten by locals rather than tourists. The latter prefer the traditional ascent to Tâmpa, which starts behind Tâmpa Residence complex.
The road climbs moderately, with just a short more challenging part in the beginning. Otherwise, the path offers an opportunity to enjoy the forest with its shapes and sounds. Shortly before reaching the Tâmpa Saddle, there is a beautiful, less known panorama towards the city, dominated by the CET tower, near the exitway to Hărman.
In the second part, the path follows the Knights' Road, which is said to have been used to descend from the fortress on Tâmpa to the lower town. Although now, in some places, the path seems much too narrow to allow riding, who knows what the relief looked like before the Middle Ages.
With one eye on your steps, the other to the city panorama on your left, you arrive at the well-known Serpentine Road, and continue the descent, most likely, with several tourists.

title: Capim Açu Trail
short_description: Lookout points with incredible views, caves and natural pools hidden between rocks, steep slopes that accompany a beautiful blue sea are some of the attractions of this trail.
long_description:
The Capim Açu é a 7km U-shaped trail, usually made around six hours of heavy walking, which offers views of the seas of Dentro and Fora, between the beaches of Sancho and Leão.Starting from a dirt road in the village of Quixaba, the trail begins steeply on the steep slope that gives access to the lighthouse used by the Navy for guidance of ships and aircraft.
After this step and followed in zigzagging between high vegetation, the trail descends to the sea level, towards the Capim-Açu Cave, which has restricted access only in times of calmer seas. Soon after, there are some beautiful natural pools that are inviting for a refreshing swim. After a tiring walk over rocks, Praia do Leatilde?o can be seen, where the trail ends. This beach is considered one of the most beautiful beaches in Brazil, with a sea of green waters and some really unforgettable blue tones.

title: Ruy Braga Crossing in Itatiaia Park - Day 1
short_description: Traverse that connects the two parts of the Itatiaia National Park, with overnight. The first day starts at the Rebouças Shelter and goes until the Shelter Água Branca.
long_description:
The traverse Ruy Braga of the Itatiaia National Park has a total of 22 kilometers, which connects the Low Part surrounded by the vegetation of the Atlantic Forest à High Part, which are the altitude fields with low vegetation of the Park. The travesía can be done in either direction but must be booked and authorised in advance by the Park administration. <Depending on your physical condition, the Traverse can be done in one or two days, being necessary to book advance case of overnight stay (shelters Água Branca Massena). In this tracklog, direction chosen was starting at Rebouças Shelter, upper part, and going Visitors Center lower with Shelter Branca.
On the first day, é possible to see the most famous attractions of the Park, as the Pico das Agulhas Negras and the Prateleiras, as well as much of the Itatiaia Plateau. At the end of the day, the destination is the Abrigo Água Branca, which is located 1,700 metres above sea level, has an incredible view of the Mantiquirast mountain range and is approximately 2.5 kilometres from the main trail.

title: Baumwipfelpfad & Tier-Freigelände im Nationalparkzentrum Lusen
short_description: Eine leichte, aussichtsreiche Rundtour mit vielen Tieren und Erlebnisstationen.
long_description:
Tier-Freigelände im Nationalparkzentrum Lusen
Umgeben von dichten Laub- und Nadelwäldern befindet sich das Tier-Freigelände im Nationalparkzentrum Lusen im Bayrischen Wald. Hier lassen sich frei lebende Tiere in großzügigen Gehegen und Volieren beobachten. Vom Nationalpark-Infozentrum Neuschönau beginnt man seinen Rundweg durch die Wälder. Von Bären über Otter, Käuze bis zum Luchs gibt es insgesamt 45 heimische Tierarten zu bestaunen. Während des Rundganges kommt man immer wieder an den Gehegen vorbei und kann dort die Tiere beobachten. Da die Gehege aufgrund der unterschiedlich großen Lebensräume der Tiere zum Teil relativ groß sind, sollte man sich für den 8 km langen Rundweg einen halben Tag Zeit lassen, um auch einige Tiere sehen zu können. Der Eintritt für das Freigelände ist kostenlos. Lediglich für den Parkplatz wird eine Pauschale verlangt.
Baumwipfelpfad Bayerischer Wald
Nach der Tour durch das Tier-Freigelände, kann man sich anschließend mit einer grandiosen Aussicht belohnen auf dem Aussichtsturm des Baumwipfelpfades. Der Pfad ist mit einer Gesamtlänge von 1.300 Metern einer der längsten der Art. Auf dem Weg zum Aussichtsturm befinden sich in bis zu 25 Metern Höhe einige Lern- bzw. Erlebnisstationen, an denen man spielerisch die Tier- und Pflanzenwelt des Bayrischen Waldes entdecken kann. Der Höhepunkt des Pfads ist dann der 44 Meter hohe Baumturm.

title: A trip to a viewpoint on the Saarschleife

long_description:
This hiking route is beautiful and easy and it leads to a stunning, central and unique view point on the beautiful Saarschleife. The route is level and is in principle accessible to strollers as well as wheelchairs.
Those who want to enjoy a higher vantage point on the place can do so through the high platform in the treetops park on the spot (admission fee). It is also possible to continue a little with the path into the forest and enjoy additional scenic points.
The information on this page includes information about the route leading up to the central view point and it is linear.

title: GT20: Bastia - Bonifacio (full route)
short_description: The GT 20 is to cycling adventure what the GR 20 is to hiking. It's a "Grande Traversée" of Corsica, specifically designed to be cycled by road bike, or even by electric bike, thanks to the 10 charging points available along the way.
long_description:
The route is divided into 13 stages, covering 550 kilometers, from Bastia to Bonifacio (or vice versa).
Here are five highlights:
Landscape diversity: From the wild coast of Cap Corse to the dreamy beaches of the south, via the majestic mountains of the interior, the GT20 offers an impressive variety of landscapes.
Cultural heritage: The route passes through picturesque and historic villages such as Corte, allowing you to discover the richness of Corsica's heritage, with its churches, fortresses and museums.
Sporting challenges: The GT20 is a physically demanding adventure with significant climbs, such as the Col de Vergio, offering a challenge to seasoned cyclists.
Local gastronomy: Stops offer the chance to sample local specialties such as brocciu, Corsican charcuterie and regional wines, enriching the experience with authentic flavors.
Natural beauty: The route includes remarkable natural sites such as the Calanques de Piana and the Bouches de Bonifacio nature reserve, highlighting the island's biodiversity and raw beauty.

title: Scenic tour of the south coast of England - Beachy Head
short_description: If you're planning a holiday on the south coast of England, in Eastbourne or nearby, a trip to Beachy Head is a must;
long_description:
Beachy Head is the highest point on the English south coast, and is on the long-distance South Downs Way, which starts at Eastbourne and ends at Winchester (Hampshire).
The long route traverses the area's scenic white limestone ridges just înear Eastbourne, and this walk represents a small portion of it.
Although at first glance it doesn't seem like it, the walk has a few climbs that those less used to physical exertion or even younger children might find insurmountable. But with willpower and continuous admiration of the superb views, the final destination can be reached.
The change can be made either way or back and forth along the same route. Along the way you'll find several points where you can approach the edge of the coast to admire it before arriving at the actual boat.

title: Around Immenstadt
short_description: On this hike, we experience the diversity around Immenstadt. Historic buildings and varied natural areas lie together in a small area.
long_description:
Immenstadt is the only town in the Oberallgäu with a historic town centre. This is why there are many old, often lovingly restored houses here. The town palace on Marienplatz is particularly worth seeing.
We hike along the Immenstädter Horn, where the traces of the major landslide in 2006 are still clearly visible. Like the Nagelfluh mountain range, the Immenstädter Horn consists largely of Nagelfluh rock. Nagelfluh is round rock that has been cemented with sand or lime under high pressure. Weathering creates the characteristic nail-head-like formations on the surface.
In Bühl am Alpsee, we pass St. Stephen's Church and the pilgrimage church of Maria Loreto, a true-to-scale replica of the chapel in Ancona, Italy.
We pass Bühl harbour and the large Alpsee lake on our way to the double castle of Rothenfels-Hugofels, which dates back to the 13th century. We cross lush meadows to reach Alpe Rothenfels, where we can stop for a cosy break.

title: Oostvaardersplassen walk
short_description: Oostvaardersplassen is part of the Netherlands' newest national park. Oostvaardersplassen was created by the reclamation of the Flevopolder.
long_description: Oostvaardersplassen is a reed swamp. This means that reed beds and willow forests can be found in the marsh. Oostvaardersplassen are of great importance for birds. Specially, many birds come to breed there and many birds of prey can be found. For example, the Oostvaardersplassen are the habitat of the White-tailed Eagle. Besides the white-tailed eagle, red deer and Konik horses can also be found there. The grazers ensure that Oostvaardersplassen remains an open plain.

title: Loop of the Grand Canal of the Château de Versailles
short_description: An easy course in the majestic setting of the park of the chateau of Versailles
long_description:
The Grand Canal is the work of Louis XIV's gardener, André le Nôtre. This part of the chateau's park was originally a wetland that this genius gardener transformed into a gigantic water reservoir.
The Tour du Canal is paved with asphalt and is the largest of its kind in France.
The Tour du Canal is tarred and homemade, the other part of the course is on gravel. For many local riders, this course offers a fabulous training ground with views of the canal and its surroundings.
Open daily:
High season (Spring / summer): 7am - 8.30pm
Low season (Autumn / Winter): 8am - 6pm
Entrance to the park with a vehicle is subject to a fee. Free parking is available near the Porte Saint Antoine.
Bars and restaurants are available.
Bars and restaurants are open in high season and on some days in low season.
If running is not enough for you, you can also rent bicycles and boats.
Dogs are not allowed in the park.
Dogs are not allowed in the gardens (near the castle) and must be kept on a leash in the park.

title: राजगीर विश्व शांति स्तूप ट्रैक
short_description: यह बिहार राज्य के राजगीर शहर में मौजूद एक बेहद सुन्दर ट्रैक है जो की एक बौद्ध धर्म के एक विशाल विश्व शांति स्तूप तक जाता है। यह घोड़ा-कटोरा झील ट्र ैका का साथी ट्रैक है।
long_description:
बिहार राज्य के राजगीर शहर से शुरू होने वाली यह हाइकिंग ट्रेल करीब साढ़े तीन किलोमीटर लंबी 'लूप ट्रेल' है। पंत वन्यजीव अभयारण्य के अंदर जाने वाली यह ट्रेल खासतौर पर हाइकिंग और तीर्थस्थल यात्रा के लिए एकदम बढ़िया है। हरियाली वाला वातावरण इस ट्रेल की पहचान है। इस ट्रेल में कई किस्म के पक्षी दिखने की संभावना भी रहती है।
ट्रेल की बात करें तो यह 'लूप ट्रेल' किस्म की आसान स्तर वाली हाइकिंग ट्रेल है। पूरी ट्रेल में हलकी चढ़ाई है लेकिन यह कोई खास कठिन नहीं है। ट्रेल का शुरूआती बिंदु विश्व स्तूप रोड का गोल चक्कर है और फिर उसके बाद का पूरा रास्ता एक सुन्दर नेचर ट्रेल है। हाईक के दौरान बौद्ध स्तूप, गृद्धकूट शिखर, सुगराखता गुफा ट्रेल मार्ग पर पड़ते हैं। ट्रेल से वापस लौटे समय सीढ़ियों से या फिर रोपवे (केबल कार) से लौटना भी संभव है।

title: Thermal baths on the northern bathing line
short_description: Soaking in the warm water after a long roll is always a turn off. This thermal loop connects 32 thermal baths in the north of Hungary in a cycle tour lasting several days.
long_description: This thermal trough leads from Fehérgyarmat all the way to Balf. We cycle from the distilleries near the Szamos through the Bodrogköz and the Tokaj wine region all the way to the Bükk. Then we will cross the Mátra through the Scythians to the Kékes Roof and cross the Danube at Szentendre Island. We pass at the foot of the Visegrád Hills and then choose between Slovak and Hungarian baths. After the settlements of the Szigetköz and Csallóköz, the tour ends near Lake Fertő, from where Sopron is just a stone's throw away. Along the way, you will visit several famous castles and palaces, such as Sárospatak Castle and Eszterházy Castle. We will also see the natural wonders of the country, such as the Danube Bend or the Egerszalók salt hills. There are also many religious centres and pilgrimage sites along the way. After each stage, you can soak in thermal waters, many of which are therapeutic waters for treating diseases of the musculoskeletal system, making this series of hikes an excellent way to exercise and maintain your joints.

title: Route Circuito do Abraão
short_description: Easy walk to discover places near by the Abraão Village, such as the Big Well (Poção), the Aqueduct (Aqueduto do Abraão),  the Lazareto ruins and the beaches of Galego (Praia do Galego) and Black (Praia Preta).
long_description: This route is ideal trail for those who are staying in Vila do Abraão and want to take an easy walk to get to know the surroundings of the village. The trail goes through areas of beautiful natural landscapes such as Cachoeira dos Escravos, also known as "Poção", the beaches Praia do Galego and Praia Preta - which has sands with an amazing coloration of gold and black, due to the presence of heavy metals, like the monazite. In this trail you will also explore and discover important monuments of Brazilian history such as the Aqueduct and the ruins of Lazareto, a former quarantine hospital for immigrants arriving in Brazil and later transformed into a prison.

title: Dwejra hiking trail
short_description: Challenging circular walk from Victoria to Gozo's landmark – the Azure Window
long_description: On the rewarding hike in the west of the island of Gozo we discover many highlights. The Azure Window is probably the most famous sight of the Maltese island. The rock gate rises about 40 m out of the sea and offers a unique view of the turquoise sea. However, because erosion is gnawing away at the landmark, it has been losing stability for several years and will probably collapse one day. In the immediate vicinity of the large rock gate we discover Fungus Rock with its rare plant life and dare to jump into the cold water of the inland sea, a naturally formed salt water lake. Those interested in culture can take a closer look at the fortifications of the capital Victoria or the Dwejra Tower on the way.

title: Hiking to beautiful Kudle Beach in Gokarna
short_description: The hiking route to Kudle Beach is a combination of urban and nature trails that starts from the main bus station of Gokarna city and ends in the majestic Kudle Beach.
long_description:
Kudle Beach, a secluded yet accessible beach in the city of Gokarna, is a long time favourite of nature lovers. Surrounded by tall coconut trees, this sea beach with its pristine golden sand looks like a perfectly shaped 'C' of the English alphabet.
Kudle beach is located just a short distance between Half-Moon Beach and Om Beach. This serene beach is famous for its amazing sunset views. It is possible to spend leisure time with your partner and family here, as there is not much crowd of tourists. But don't be surprised if you see some locals here in the morning and evening actively engaging in brisks walks and yoga practice.
Apart from taking a stroll in the golden sands washed with gentle waves and enjoying local food at the many amazing cafe's located around Kudle beach, it is certainly possible to plan a night camping. There is nothing more pleasurable than watching at night the beauty of the glittering waters in the moonlight from one of the many bamboo huts and shacks built along the beach.

title: Alde Feanen walking route
short_description: This walking route is 26.5 kilometres long and takes about 6.5 hours.
long_description: National park Alde Feanen is an extraordinary nature reserve in Friesland. It consists of marshes, fens, lakes and forests. Marshes are not part of the standard landscape in the Netherlands, which is why this nature reserve is so special.

title: बेदिनी बुग्याल ट्रैक
short_description: चीड़, बांझ, और बुराँश के घने जंगलों से होकर बेदिनी बुग्याल के अल्पाइन चरागाह का यह ट्रैक न सिर्फ भारत बल्कि शायद दुनिया भर के सभी अल्पाइन मैदानों के ट्रैक में सबसे ज्यादा सुन्दर ह ै।
long_description:
अगर आपने आज से पहले 'बुग्याल' शब्द नहीं सुना था तो कोई आश्चर्य की बात नहीं है क्योंकि यह कुमाँऊनी भाषा का ख़ास शब्द है जो सिर्फ उत्तराखंड राज्य के ऊंचाई वाले अप्लाइन चारागाहों के लिए इस्तेमाल होता है। बुग्याल समतल या हल्की ढलान वाले हिमालयी क्षेत्र के घास के मैदानों को कहते हैं। 9000 फीट से 13000 फीट की ऊंचाई पर पाए जाने वाले इन मैदानों में मवेशियों को चराया जाता है। सर्दियों में बर्फ की चादर और गर्मियों में फूलों की चादर से ढके हुए इन सुन्दर बुग्यालों में हाईकिंग करना एक अनोखा जादुई अनुभव है।
बेदिनी बुग्याल वान गांव के पास रूपकुंड झील ट्रैक के रास्ते में पड़ता है।
लोहाजंग गाँव में 7500 फीट की ऊंचाई से शुरू होकर बेदिनी बुग्याल में 12000 फ़ीट की ऊंचाई पर ख़त्म होने वाला यह ट्रैक लंबा ज़रूर है पर ज्यादा मुश्किल नहीं। यह अनुभवी और नौसिखिए दोनों किस्म के हाइकर्स के लिए उपयुक्त है। ट्रेल करीब 19 किलोमीटर लम्बी है ।ट्रेल की चढ़ाई मध्यम है और यह बांझ बुरांश के घने जंगल से होकर गुजरती है, जहाँ के कुछ पेड़ कमसकम 1000 साल पुराने हैं।
यात्रा के दौरान ददनी गाँव, तोलपानी गाँव, अबिन खड़क गाँव और अंत में बेदिनी बुग्याल में बेस कैंप लगाने चाहिए। ज्यादातर हाइकर्स को ट्रैकिंग की शुरुआत से पहले अच्छे से जलवायु अभ्यस्त (acclimatization) होने के बाद कोई भी थकान महसूस नहीं होनी चाहिए।
बेदिनी से त्रिशूल और नंदा घुंटी पर्वत शिखर साफ दिखाई देते हैं। बेदिनी में वैतरणी नाम की एक छोटी सी झील भी है जिसे बेदिनी कुंड भी कहा जाता है। इस हरेभरे घास के मैदान में कई प्रकार के फूल खिलते हैं। ऐसी मान्यता है की इलाके की सबसे दुर्लभ फूल 'ब्रह्म कमल' हर किसी को नहीं दिखाई देता है।
हालाँकि पास ही के आली बुग्याल में शिविर और तम्बू लगाने पर सख्त प्रतिबंध है, लेकिन बेदिनी बुग्याल में एक शिविर स्थल है जहाँ तम्बू में रात बिताई जा सकती है और हिमालय की स्वच्छ शुद्ध हवा के साथ साथ सूर्योदय/सूर्यास्त का आनंद लिया जा सकता है।

title: From the Pradollano ski station to the giant telescope of the Observatorio del Pico Veleta in Sierra Nevada
short_description:
This tour has everything you can do in a few hours. Great views, high altitude, steep inclines and visits from many animals. In September there is also - the silence, I was alone on the road today in dream weather. Since you are only a stone's throw from the sea, you can marvel at the roof of Europe in one day (the Veleta peak is Europe's highest pass) and then take a dip in the sea (Motril is the next town).
.
As Granada has its own airport and is also only about 100 KM from Malaga, the Sierra Nevada should not be missed during a visit to Andalusia.
long_description:
We set off near the valley station. You can drive another two kilometres by car and save yourself about 200 metres in altitude. There are no parking problems here in the low season.
The trail leads over blue and red slopes of the ski area. I always had my optical target, the big telescope, in sight and could not get lost. At the co-testing station, I took a shortcut over a black slope that required climbing ability (on all fours). But you can easily avoid this difficulty by taking the diversions via the blue slope. Afterwards, you are treated to views of the two mountain peaks and reach the telescope after a few serpentines.
I descended via the snowboarding slope and could easily imagine the downhill bikers jumping over the moguls in the summer. 
Summarising: Two very strenuous hours, which could be extended to 4 hours. Wonderful also for trail runners.

title: Kust till Kustleden - from Vesslarp to Trollabackarna
short_description: The sixth stage of the Kust till Kustledens leads from the Vesslarp campsite through deep spruce forests and past moors to the Trollabackarna campsite.
long_description: We hike through a dense coniferous forest, which is only rarely broken by open spaces. Soon we pass several elongated depressions in the ground, which are so-called tar valleys. Tar was traditionally produced here by smouldering pine wood. Furthermore, along the path we find drying houses for flax in cattle trails, which testify to the early agriculture in the region. Finally, we climb up to the Trollabackarna hill, where we have a beautiful view over the surrounding forests.

title: Snowshoe tour from Jungholz to the Alpe Stubental
short_description: moderately difficult snowshoe hike from Jungholz over the Pfeifferberg to the Alpe Stubental with some purest views into the nature of Jungholz.
long_description: We embark on a two-hour snowshoe hike along the Jungholzer Höhenweg with beautiful viewpoints and a great view to the Tyrolean and Allgäu nature and landscape. The end of the route, the Alpe Stubental, is also the well-deserved reward with a traditional host and delicious food.

title: Kalkan - Patara
short_description: The route starting from Kalkan end connects to the nature trail through various facilities and venues and then you arrive at Patara Beach via Gelemiş.
long_description:
One of the routes overlooking the sea is the Kalkan - Patara route. It is one of the most beautiful routes that you can do in Antalya, one of the most sought-after holiday destinations in Turkey by local and foreign tourists, offering nature trails.
The route starts from Kalkan Fener, one end of Kalkan. After walking through the businesses for a while, you set off towards Gelemiş from a line on the coastal side. After leaving the coastal bölge behind, your height gradually increases until Gelemiş. After a long walk in the greenery, you reach Gelemiş and from there you arrive at Patara Beach accompanied by Patara Sand Dunes. 
There are different routes you can travel between Kalkan and Patara. This route, which is one of the various routes that offer different things from each other, offers a pleasant journey as well as introducing the beauties of Kalkan - Patara.

title: Nordrandweg (Black Forest)
short_description: The Nordrandweg is a scenic hiking trail in the northern Black Forest. We hike through the tranquil Enz valley from Mühlacker past Pforzheim to Karlsruhe-Durlach.
long_description:
Stage 1: Mühlacker - Pforzheim (19 km)
We start our hike in Mühlacker, pass the Löffelstelz castle ruins and ücross the Enz river. We should also pay a short visit to the Renaissance castle of Mühlhausen. Behind Dürrmenz we enter the forest and walk up to Steckhof and Tannenberg. Now we hike slightly downhill to Niefern-Öschelbronn, where we can visit Niefernburg Castle, the Protestant church and the Kirnbach Museum. We then make our way to Kirnbach and through the forest to Eutingen, crossing the Enz River again. With a detour to the west, we reach Pforzheim, the destination of today's stage, whose collegiate church of St. Michael can be seen from far away.
Stage 2: Pforzheim - Langensteinbach (19.5 km)
Our day tour starts in Pforzheim and leads directly into the Black Forest. After passing the Römerberg, we hike past Dietlingen and enjoy the view of the surrounding vineyards. After Keltern we walk above the Pfinz river to Weiler. Here we turn west and only have to cross a forest before we reach the finish of the stage.
Stage 3: Langensteinbach - Durlach (16 km)
Past Langensteinbach Castle, we hike to the Rappenbusch forest. We cross the A8 and then walk in a large arc around the village of Stupferich to turn right shortly before Thomashof. Once again the Black Forest lives up to its name and a wonderful forest trail awaits us. From the Turmberg we have a good view over Karlsruhe. We quickly covered the short distance to its district of Durlach, with Karlsburg Castle, and arrived at the finishing point of the Nordrandweg.

title: Lakes around Korotsko
short_description: Loop that includes a part of the Big Valdai Trail. Moves through forests, fields and meadows, and touches the shore of several lakes. Great resting places, and very changing landscape.

title: Bourbon Cycle Route - From Bari to Naples
short_description:
The so-called Bourbon Cycle Route takes us across the Italian peninsula from East to West, starting in Bari on the Adriatic Sea and arriving in Naples on the Tyrrhenian Sea.
The cycle route of the Bourbons takes us from Bari on the Adriatic Sea to Naples on the Tyrrhenian Sea.
long_description: This is a project conceived by FIAB and inaugurated in 2010. It is named after the famous Bourbon kingdom of Naples in the 19th century.

title: NiederrheinWeg
short_description: The NiederrheinWeg leads on a circular route of approx. 130 km through North Rhine-Westphalia. The long-distance hiking trail, managed by the Niederrheinische Berg- und Wanderfreunde, has been fully signposted since 2008 and leads through charming landscapes and culturally interesting towns and villages on seven varied daily stages. The manageable number of metres in altitude gives us plenty of time to enjoy the sights along the way.
long_description: The NiederrheinWeh is a 132 km long hiking trail on the left bank of the Niederrein, which was created in the course of 2007 and 2008 through an initiative of the Niederrheinischer Berg- und Wanderfrende-Verein. We hike for the most part in the southern Wesel district, as well as in the southeast of the Kleve district. Our route leads along agricultural paths between the towns of Moers, Neukirchen-Vluyn, Rheurdt, Kamp-Lintfort, Issum, Alpen and Rheinberg.

title: किपलिंग ट्रेल, उत्तराखंड, भारत
short_description: यह अंग्रेजी लेखक रुडयार्ड किपलिंग के नाम वाली पुरानी, रोमांचक ट्रेल हैं जो देहरादून को मसूरी से जो ड़ती है। घोड़ागाड़ी, बस और कार की सड़को से पहले , यह मसूरी पहुंचने का एकमात्र जरिया थी।
long_description:
किपलिंग ट्रेल 9 किलोमीटर लमार्ग जो शहंशाह आश्रम देहरादून में शुरू होकर झरीपानी और बार्लोगंज गाँवों से होते हुए मसूरी तक जाता है। ऐसा माना जाता है कि इस ट्रेल की खोज सबसे पहले नोबेल पुरस्कार विजेता, मोगली और जंगल बुक वाले अंग्रेजी लेखक रूडयार्ड किपलिंग ने की थी।
भारत के ब्रिटिश राज के दौरान, यह मार्ग सामरिक रूप से बहुत महत्वपूर्ण था क्योंकि यह सैन्य रूप से महत्वपूर्ण देहरादून को आरामदायक मसूरी से जोड़कर कार्य-जीवन का संतुलन बनाए रखता था।
यह घुमावदार सर्पिन ट्रेल एक ओर हिमालय की तलहटी और दूसरी तरफ देहरादून घाटी के शानदार दृश्य पेश करती है। ट्रेल मार्ग में बर्लोगंज और झिरपानी के सुन्दर गाँव आते हैं और प्रजनन काल में इस मार्ग में कई दुर्लभ पक्षी देखे जा सकते हैं।
किपलिंग ट्रेल 30-35 डिग्री की चढ़ाई वाली है। वैसे हो यह चढ़ाई लगभग पूरे 9 किमी के मार्ग में मौजूद है, लेकिन चिंता करने की कोई बात नहीं है क्योंकि धीमी और स्थिर गति से चलकर इसे आसानी से पूरा किया जा सकता है।
यह ट्रेक शुरुआती पदयात्रियों के लिए उपयुक्त है और इसके खड़ी चढ़ाई अनुभवी ट्रेकर्स को भी चुनौती देगी !

title: Kizilcahamam Observation Terrace Round Trip
short_description: An observation terrace where you can watch the magnificent forest texture of Ankara from the top of the hill
long_description:
Ankara is a city rich in forest texture, viewing terraces and the views they offer. There is always something to discover while travelling routes in Ankara and its surroundings. Mountainous terrains, living life in the terrains, plant vegetation, or the vast expanses of the winter landscape...
This circular route takes you to Kızılcahamam Seyir Hill. When you arrive at the Seyir Hill, you are greeted with a wonderful view. It is impossible not to be impressed by the view. The abundance of oxygen, the greenery and the beauty of nature almost take you to another point and it is good for the soul. After completing the route, it is priceless to sit here for a while to calm down and find peace.
The terrace allows you to take magnificent nature view photos due to its location. If you are looking for a point in Ankara where you will connect with nature and leave an impression on you, be sure to come to the observation terrace with this route.

title: Walking route national park Weeribben Wieden north
short_description: This route is about 11 kilometres long and takes 3 hours.
long_description: National Park Weeribben Wieden is a beautiful nature reserve consisting mainly of water. You will find many streams and fens. The area is a bit marshy. Especially if it has rained a lot, it can be muddy.

title: Jabre Peak Trail
short_description: The Jabre Peak enchants its visitors with its characteristic flora and fauna and a dazzling sunset.
long_description:
The Pico do Jabre State Park is a conservation unit created in 1992 to protect the fauna and flora around the Pico do Jabre. Maturéia city hall has recently installed a Tourist Support Unit and has been encouraging ecological tourism in the region.
The ideal way to do this trail, as well as to get to know the other attractions in the region, is to stay in one of the bucolic pousadas in Maturéia. The Casar do Jabre is a great tip, as it is not only near the start of the trail to Pico do Jabre, but also offers a great infrastructure for visitors. To get to the top you can use a shorter trail, the Pai Dantas trail, or the paved path that is also used by cars and bicycles, but is longer.

title: A trip to the Niederzonthofen waterfall (the short route)
short_description: A short (but slightly challenging) hiking route that leads by the shortest route to the impressive Niederzonthofen waterfall in the upper Allgäu region of southern Germany
long_description:
A relatively short hiking route starting from the village of Rieggis leading through a forest to a waterfall called Niedersonthofen Fall. The hiking route is linear, on the way the walk is downhill which you will have to climb on the way back (reasonable slope). It itself is not long, but the terrain conditions make walking on it somewhat challenging and it is therefore important to pay attention to where you are walking. Also, the nature of the road makes it inaccessible to strollers/wheelchairs. The destination of the route is the impressive waterfall and the walk through the forest itself is absolutely beautiful.
There is another, longer road leading to the waterfall next to watercourses starting from the village of Niedersonthofen.

title: Mt Iwayuku Diamond Trail Takihata - Mt Iwayuku summit - Kimitoge Station
short_description: Walk part of the Diamond Trail, one of the most popular traverse routes in the Kansai region. It is easy to walk, even for beginners, and in autumn the panoramic view of the silver grass fields at the summit and the urban areas of Osaka and Kobe can be enjoyed.
long_description:
This 897 m-high mountain is easily accessible from the Kansai region and attracts many climbers because of the 360° panoramic view from the summit. The summit area is also one of the few places in the country where silver grass meadows, known as 'Kitra', are famous, and in autumn the whole area is dyed a golden colour by silver grass. This course is part of the Diamond Trail, one of the most popular traversing routes in the Kansai region. From the trail, you can walk from west to east along the ridge with views of the Osaka Plain below and the Rokko mountain range in the distance.
The trail starts from a bus stop south of the Takihata Dam, and the forest path begins from a staircase behind the toilets in the pay car park. 25 minutes' walk takes you to a place called Kakizako, where you can rest on a bench. Take a rest here on a bench. From there, you can see Mount Minamikatsuragi across the road, and the mountain surface is beautifully coloured in autumn. After walking through a wooded area, you will come to an open area again and see a railway tower. Afterwards, a gently sloping ridge path opens up in front of you and a field of silver grass spreads out. A steep staircase leads up to the summit. The summit offers an unobstructed panoramic view of the Takihata Dam at the trailhead, Mt Nijo, Mt Katsuragi, Mt Kongo, Mt Atago-yama in Kyoto, as well as the Osaka Plain, Osaka Bay, the Kobe city area, Mt Rokko and Awaji Island.
Descending further to the east, the trail heads towards Kimitoge Station on the Nankai Koya Line. The trail descends on a wooden path through Kayaba and soon comes to a toilet; check the signs each time as there are places where it is a little difficult to know which way to go, such as Gotsuji where five branches converge and the Minamikatsujōzan branch. After crossing the third station of Mt Iwayuku, the descent becomes steep and rough, so walk carefully. After an hour's walk from Gotsuji, you will reach the Koshigataki branch and walk along the thickly wooded path along the Neko River until the end of the forest road. From there, walk south along the railway line to reach the goal at Kimitoge Station on the Nankai Koya Line.

title: आली बुग्याल ट्रैक
short_description: हिमालयी चोटियों के दृश्य और बाँझ-बुरांश के जंगलों वाला आली बुग ्याल ट्रैक न सिर्फ भारत बल्कि शायद पूरी दुनिया के सभी अल्पाइन घास के मैदानों के ट्रैक में सबसे ज्यादा सुन्दर है।
long_description:
बुग्याल शब्द खासतौर पर सिर्फ हिमालयी राज्य उत्तराखंड के चारागाहों के लिए इस्तेमाल होता है। बुग्याल समतल या हल्की ढलान वाले नाजुक इकोलॉजिकल अल्पाइन चारागाह या घास के मैदानों को कहते हैं। यह हिमालय क्षेत्र में 9000 फीट से 13000 फीट की ऊंचाई पर पाए जाते हैं और मवेशियों को चराने के लिए इस्तेमाल किए जाते हैं। सर्दियों में बर्फ की चादर और गर्मियों में  फूलों की बहार से ढके हुए बुग्याल बेहद सुन्दर दिखते हैं और उन तक हाईकिंग करना अपने आप में एक अनोखी श्रेणी और अनुभव है।
लगभग 8500 फीट की ऊंचाई से शुरू होने और 12000 फीट की ऊंचाई पर ख़त्म होने के बावजूद आली बुग्याल ट्रैक ज्यादा मुश्किल नहीं है। यह अनुभवी और नौसिखिए दोनों के लिए उपयुक्त है। ट्रेल की चढ़ाई हलकी है।  पगडंडी मार्ग ओक और बुरांश के घने जंगल से होकर गुजरता है, जहाँ के पेड़ आसानी से 1000 साल पुराने हैं। पूरा ट्रेल मार्ग करीब 13 किलोमीटर लंबा है। ददनी गाँव (जो ट्रैक के शुरुआती बिंदु लोहाजंग से करीब 7 किलोमीटर दूर है ) या फिर तोलपानी गाँव (लोहाजंग से 9 किलोमीटर दूर) को पहले दिन बेस कैंप बनाना चाहिए और वहां रात गुजारनी चाहिए। अगले दिन बाकी बची हुई यात्रा जारी रखनी चाहिए।
ज्यादातर हाइकर्स को  ट्रैकिंग की शुरुआत से पहले ठीक से जलवायु अभ्यस्त (acclimatization) होने के बाद कोई भी थकान महसूस नहीं होनी चाहिए।
जहाँ गर्मियों में आली बुग्याल पहुंचने के बाद हाइकर्स का स्वागत हरी घास के मखमली कालीन, रंग बिरंगे फूलों और चिड़ियों की आवाजों से होता है वहीँ सर्दियों में हाइकर्स को दूर दूर तक सफ़ेद बर्फ की चादर और अनोखा सन्नाटा और शांति मिलती है।
आली बुग्याल से हिमालयी की दमदार त्रिशूल पर्वत और नंदा घुंटी पर्वत के भव्य दृश्य दिखते है। आली बुग्याल के भीतर शिविर और तम्बू लगाने पर सख्त प्रतिबंध है, लेकिन बुग्याल के पास अबिन खड़क नामक एक शिविर स्थल है जहाँ रात बिताई जा सकती है और हिमालय की स्वच्छ शुद्ध हवा के साथ साथ सूर्योदय/सूर्यास्त का आनंद लिया जा सकता है।

आली बुग्याल के घास मैदानों की हलकी ढलानें ,उत्तराखंड भारत।

सुन्दर आली बुग्याल से दिखने वाली शानदार हिमालयी चोटियाँ, चमोली, उत्तराखंड, भारत

title: The Molokoi Trail
short_description: At 18 kilometres long, this hiking trail, marked out by the Office National des Forêts (ONF), is the longest in French Guiana, and undoubtedly the most famous. Well-maintained, it offers an authentic immersion in the heart of the Amazon rainforest, an adventure to be shared with family and friends!
long_description:
Let yourself be enchanted by the rich biodiversity of French Guiana as you make your way along the route. From crystal-clear waters to spectacular century-old trees, majestic lianas, colourful birds and monkeys, every element has its place.
The most sublime part of the trip is between Cacao and the carbets, situated halfway along the route. When you arrive at the carbets, a cove with clear waters and a natural jacuzzi, just a few steps away, awaits you for a well-deserved break. If you're feeling brave, end the break with a fish-pedicure after hours of walking.

title: Walking Around Uzungol
short_description: Full tour around Uzung&ouml'l, which offers spectacular nature views
long_description:
One of the paradise towns of Trabzon is Uzungöl. In addition to the charming gölül, the forest texture and clean air around the gölül makes it a unique natural wonder. Uzungöl, which offers interesting views in summer and winter, is frequently preferred by local and foreign tourists and is the subject of many photographs.
The yürüyüyüş road, which makes a full circuit in the almost göl çphase, can be called the first activity done by those who come to Uzungöl. The yürüyüyüroad, which circles around the Gölün, allows you to enjoy the view of Uzungöl to the fullest and photograph this natural beauty from every angle. There are many facilities around the mountain. 
In addition to this route, which offers unique natural landscapes, but is done on a normal hiking route, there are also challenging trekking routes in the region. Many people who explore the area around the göl then go trekking in the highlands close to the göl.

title: Leisurely jog around Lake Ortwang
short_description:
Along the Ostrach and around Lake Ortwang, the beautiful landscape can be glimpsed. 
Perfectly suited for a short, leisurely run.

The route is very popular with joggers, as it can be used all year round.
In addition to the beautiful view of, for example, midday, Lake Ortwang offers the opportunity to cool off after the run.

title: Late winter hike to the Alpspitze
short_description: The Alpspitze is a rewarding lookout mountain on the edge of the Allgäu Alps.
long_description: The Alpspitze can be reached all year round, depending on the snow conditions, as it is also possible to ascend with the Alpspitzbahn. Towards the end of winter, the amount of snow has usually decreased to such an extent that an ascent from the valley can be tackled very well. The summit offers wonderful views of the Alpine foothills and the Allgäu Alps.

title: Bekal Tal Track
short_description: Bekal Tal is an exciting winter trek route in Uttarakhand. It is a part of the Lohajung-Brahmatal track route and is perfect for those who are short of both time and experience.
long_description:
Many world famous trails like Aali Bugyal, Bedini Bugyal, Roopkund, Dodital etc start from Lohajung village in Chamoli district of Uttarakhand. For the recent few years, the names of Bekal Tal and Brahma Tal Trail have also been added to this list. Many hikers are now giving equal importance to the Brahma Tal trek as the Roopkund trek. The Bekal Tal track falls on this Brahmatal track route.
Bekal Tal is about 6 kilometers from Lohajung and in a way acts as the mid point of the Brahma Tal trek. Although experienced hikers can complete this trek in a day if they say, but spending a night in Bekal Tal has its own unique charm, so everyone plans a two-day trek for this trek.
The trek to Bekal Tal is of moderate difficulty and the best time to do it is either during the snow in winter or when the snow starts melting in spring. The track is not particularly enjoyable in summers and rains. The Bekal Tal track also has the confluence of the Kali and Pindari rivers. This track route actually comes under Kali Ghati. About 300 meters before coming to Bekal Tal, there is a small lake called Khopdaliya which has a good camping place. Most of the hikers pitch their tents at Khopdalia lake itself.

title: Ocelot Trail in Cantareira Park
short_description: Very nice walk to do with the whole family, including children. The trail is immersed in a large remnant of Atlantic Forest, in the Cantareira State Park in SP.
long_description:
The Núcleo Cabuçu is located in the municipality of Guarulhos, in São Paulo, and was opened to the public in 2008. The park offers good infrastructure with parking, toilets, picnic areas, a Visitors' Centre and four beautiful trails for nature interpretation.
The Ocelot Trail is only 2.5km long (round trip) and is ideal for children. The trail passes beside the beautiful Cabuçu Dam, a historic Brazilian construction.
The Cantareira State Park é divided into four núcleos and was inaugurated in 1963. In 1994, it was declared part of the Green Belt Biosphere Reserve of the city of São Paulo by UNESCO.

title: On ancient paths to Chinamada
short_description: On our hike we visit the village of Chinamada, where the Guanches (the indigenous people of Tenerife) lived in caves.
long_description: This panoramic circular walk takes us from Las Carboneras to the remote and very impressive mountain village of Chinamada. Only a few people still live here in their cave dwellings.

title: La Régalante: from Mont Saint-Michel to Nantes
short_description: The Régalante links Mont Saint-Michel to Nantes by bike, offering a peaceful way to explore Brittany.
long_description:
This cycle route runs north-south, along the ancient medieval fortresses that once marked the border between Brittany and France. The only surprising detours on this historic route are to explore less-travelled paths, to discover the hidden treasures scattered throughout the surrounding countryside.
Tranquil rivers, lakes, ponds, forests, picturesque villages, medieval castles, old mines and works of art dot the route.
With pleasant stretches of greenway, low gradients, reasonable distances and gourmet stops for "galettes saucisses", this route is perfect for a first family cycling adventure.

title: A hidden oasis by the Dead Sea
short_description: A green and hidden hiking trail in the middle of the desert. A light and shady road along the Bokek stream.
long_description: A wonderful and magical hiking route along the length of Nahal Bokek. Most of the way is shaded and comfortable, where for a large part of the way you can walk next to or inside Nahal Bokek, at the beginning of the way there is a very weak flow, but as you progress along the way, the flow gets stronger and you can wade in natural pools by the side of the road. The road is rich in trees and vegetation and several small waterfalls, so it is suitable for a trip even on hot days. Most of the way is on the plain but occasionally there are small ascents or the need to climb on large stones or rock using fixed iron pegs embedded in the rock. The route is relatively less touristy, the entrance is free and it is suitable for walking with the whole family. You can make a circular trip or come back the same way at any time.

title: Walking Around Ataturk Arboretum
short_description: The Atatürk Arboretum and the surrounding nature trails not only allow you to see the arboretum where interesting trees are exhibited, but also offer an alternative route around the garden for hiking and nature activities.
long_description:
Everyone who loves trees, greenery, nature or is interested in photography has travelled to Atatürk Arboretum in Istanbul.
If you are a nature traveller and you dream of discovering new places of interest, historical, cultural, cultural and geographical values during your travels, you can try this route. We start the route from the arboretum and walk around the arboretum. Take a good look around the arboretum, which we have marked as a waypoint, and dive into every point. 
After finishing the arboretum and taking great photos, we set off for the forest part of the route. This part of the route behind the arboretum consists of a circular route. We follow the circular route and come to the arboretum again. The route ends here. 
Alternative routes allow us to discover more greenery and nature in Istanbul.

title: ब्रह्म ताल ट्रैक
short_description: बेहद सुन्दर गढ़वाल हिमालय के अधिकांश ट्रैक सर्दियों के दौरान खतरनाक स्थितियों और लचर सुविधाओं की वजह से मुश्किल होते हैं, लेकिन ब्रह्म ताल एक ऐसी खूबसूरत अल्पाइन झील है जिसमें सर्दियों में ट्रैकिंग और कैंपिंग करना संभव है।
long_description:
उत्तराखंड के चमोली ज़िले के लोहाजंग गाँव से कई प्रसिद्ध ट्रैक शुरू होते हैं जैसे की आली बुग्याल, बेदिनी बुग्याल, रूपकुंड, डोडीताल आदि। अभी हाल के कुछ सालों से इस सूची में बेकल ताल और ब्रह्म ताल ट्रैक का नाम भी जुड़ गया है। कई हाइकर्स तो अब ब्रह्म ताल ट्रैक को रूपकुंड ट्रैक के बराबर ही अहमियत देने लगे हैं।
ब्रह्म ताल ट्रैक हाइकर्स को एक खूबसूरत कैंपिंग साइट वाली 12000 फ़ीट की ऊंचाई वाली अल्पाइन झील तक ले जाता है। यह झील एक क्रेटर (गड्ढे) में स्थित मीठे पानी की झील है। झील के पास एक मंदिर और दूर किनारे पर एक अकेला पेड़ खड़ा है। झील के किनारे से हिमालय की दो सबसे पर्वत चोटियाँ - माउंट त्रिशूल और माउंट नंदाघुंटी दिखती हैं। लोहाजंग से ब्रह्म ताल लगभग 8 किलोमीटर की दूरी पर है और दो दिवसीय ट्रैक है जिसमें पहली रात गुजरने के लिए सुन्दर 'बेकल ताल' झील के शिविर स्थल में रुका जाता है। बेकल ताल लगभग इस ट्रैक का मध्यवर्ती बिंदु है। ट्रैक मार्ग बुराँश और देवदार के पेड़ों से घिरा हुआ है जो की सैंकड़ों साल पुराने हैं। ट्रैक के अंत एक सुन्दर बुग्याल (अल्पाइन घास का मैदान) में होता है जहाँ पर एक झंडी टॉप और मंदिर भी है।
ब्रह्मा ताल का ट्रैक मध्यम कठिनाई वाला है और इसे करने का सबसे अच्छा समय या तो सर्दियों में बर्फ़ के दौरान या फिर बसंत में बर्फ़ पिघलना शुरू होने के दौरान है। कड़क गर्मियों और मॉनसूनी बरसात में ट्रैक कुछ ख़ास आनंददायक नहीं होता है। झील से 25 किलोमीटर तक का इलाका साफ़ साफ़ दिखाई देता है। ब्रह्म ताल ट्रैक की सहजता, सुंदरता और अनुभव इसे उत्तराखंड का सबसे बेहतरीन शीतकालीन हिमालयी ट्रैक बनाते हैं।

title: Saltpans hiking trail
short_description: Circular walk from Gozo's capital Victoria via the impressive Wied il Ghasri Gorge and the worth seeing salt pans of  Xwejni Bay
long_description: On the varied hike along the north coast of Gozo we discover the island's capital Victoria with its enthroned fortress. We also enjoy the tranquillity and crystal clear waters of the Wied il Ghasri Gorge. At the famous salt pans of Dwejra Bay, which are several centuries old, we can even observe at certain times of the year how some local families extract sea salt from the chessboard-shaped pools. But the salt ponds on the coast of Gozo, symmetrically arranged over several kilometres, also offer an unusual sight;

title: Pilatus - Heitertannliweg from Krienseregg
short_description: The hike from Krienseregg via the Heitertannliweg to Pilatus offers a varied and impressive tour through the breathtaking landscape of the Pilatus massif. The starting point is at Krienseregg, which can be easily reached by cable car from Kriens (near Lucerne).
long_description:
From here, the trail leads through a dense forest, which soon thins out to reveal increasingly spectacular views of the surrounding mountains and Lake Lucerne as far as Fräkmüntegg (1412 m above sea level).Afterwards, the route initially follows relatively easy paths, sometimes even slightly downhill, across alpine meadows and through small mountain forests to Alp Oberlauelen (1332 m above sea level).
From this point, the terrain changes abruptly. Narrow rocky paths lead uphill, sometimes very steeply. At the most challenging points, taut chains provide additional safety. A few meters in altitude are also overcome via wooden steps embedded in the rock. At almost 1900 m above sea level. M., you pass the Klimsenkapelle chapel, an ideal place to take a break and linger. The last few meters in altitude are covered on a steep serpentine path until you finally reach the summit of the Pilatus.
Once at the top, you are rewarded with an impressive 360-degree view of the Alps, the Central Plateau and the lake.
The hike takes around 3-4.5 hours, depending on your fitness level.

images.caption: Klimsenkapelle chapel with Pilatus in the background
The last few meters just below Klimsenhorn and Klimsenkapelle

title: Nettersheim - Schleifbach Valley - Urft Valley - Genfbach Valley
short_description:
The circular trail runs along the Urft, Schleifbach and Genfbach streams.
In September, the autumn crocus beckons you to take a flowering walk in a varied landscape.
Landlust, September/October 2014

title: Trail running on the Rubjerg Knude by Lønstrup, North Jutland
short_description: Explore Lønstrup's lighthouse, dunes, sea cliffs and woodland on this trail run that goes beyond what most visitors see.
long_description:
The upmarket seaside town of Lønstrup in Denmark's North Jutland region has boutiques, nice eateries, and galleries which are all very nice, but as a runner, I couldn't resist the urge to get away from the more touristy side of things and explore the natural beauty of the local coastline.   
Starting in the car park slap bang in the middle of town, this route startsd by taking you past the holiday homes that pepper the grassy sea cliffs before leading you up the first in a series of dunes to the striking lighthouse (which you can also go to the top of).  I then traversed further south to explore the forest, the secondary dunes, and the grasslands beyond. 
The route is based on the GPS track I recorded on the day and I have to say that navigation and orientation were a bit tricky in places - not least because there were some cows grazing in the area I wanted to go and extra fencing had been put up. You will find some of the tracks hard to spot and once in the sand, you will need to freestyle the best route. Signage is also pretty much non-existent. But persevere - the navigation is all part of the fun and the effort was definitely worth it.
If you enjoyed this route, why not check out my other one further up the coast: Trail running around the Råbjerg Mile, North Jutland

title: Plateau Trail in Monte Verde
short_description: The Plateau, situated in the mountains of the bucolic village of Monte Verde, is 1945 metres high and has a beautiful panoramic view of the surrounding area.
long_description:
<The village of Monte Verde, located in the Serra da Mantiqueira, attracts many visitors all year round, looking for a quiet place to relax and enjoy coldness mountains, amidst beautiful vegetation region. Besides having cozy inns, chocolate factories various local crafts, is famous its trails that offer direct unique contact with nature.
The trail to é the Platô é well signposted and suitable for all publics. However, bear in mind that it is necessary to have good physical fitness, as there are 1200 metres of almost constant ascent to the top. But do not worry, along the way there are several points to rest and viewpoints to enjoy the view. Another way to get to the Platé é through the Chapéu do Bispo Trail, which has a flatter and less strenuous route.
From the Platô you still have the option to go to Pico Selado, however there is no signposting.

title: Kust till Kustleden - from Trollabackarna to Klinten
short_description: The seventh stage of the Kust till Kustledens leads from the Trollabackarna plateau to the Klinten campsite near the town of Osby.
long_description: Past old industrial buildings, such as a mill, a paper factory and a smithy, our route leads towards Osby. Along the river Helge å we see some old farmhouses and cottages, as well as the defence fortress Hönjarum skans. Plant connoisseurs will also be pleased to see a variety of native plants along the way, and the forest is somewhat thinner throughout the tour than on the previous stages, allowing for some beautiful views.

title: Walk Wyker Promenade to the airfield, harbour and back
short_description: Easy walk from the Hotel Atlantis past the lighthouse to the south beach, always along the paved promenade. We pass the Upstalsboom Hotel and some cafes, then turn right towards the airfield. Once at the airfield, we head back towards the promenade, on which we then walk to the harbour. On the way back, we walk along the shopping mile back to the hotel.
long_description: Easy hike!

images.caption: Wanderung in Wyk auf Föhr: Wanderung Wyker Promenade zum Flugplatz, Hafen und retour

title: Sharri mountains: Over snowy slopes to Bistra Peak
short_description: Equally panoramic and challenging snowshoe ascent to Bistra, one of Kosovo’s highest peaks.
long_description: Kosovo's northern side of the Sharri Mountains offers ideal terrain for snowshoeing. From the pass town of Prevalle, this tour first leads over wide mountain crests and finally the exposed summit ridge to the two peaks of Bistra, which are over 2600 metres high. The wild beauty of the Western Balkan mountains is hardly ever as impressive as here. This tour, which is highly alpine in winter, requires not only fitness but also good climbing technique with snowshoes and a good ability to assess the current conditions. Since you are rewarded with breathtaking views of the surrounding mountain ranges almost from the first metre up, the tour is worthwhile even if you turn back below the summit ridge.

title: Xaghra - Heritage Trail
short_description: Hiking in the north-east of the island of Gozo, from Calypso Grotto to Xaghra
long_description: The route hike starts at the famous Calypso Grotto. According to legend, the enchanting nymph Calypso lived here and held Odysseus captive in the cave for seven years - at least that is what Homer's Odyssey says. From the grotto you have a beautiful view over Ramla Bay. Another highlight of the tour are the Ggantija temples. Together with other megalithic structures, they belong to the UNESCO World Cultural Heritage. The Ggantija temples, which are several thousand years old, are also among the oldest buildings of this complexity

title: Climbing B'shießer in winter (2,000 m)
short_description: A great day out in the Allgäu Alps with forests, waterfalls, and a windswept peak- not to mention a whole lot of alpine vistas.
long_description:
The area around Hinterstein is extremely popular with hikers, climbers, and day-trippers during the warmer months, but moderate winter hiking routes that come with relatively subdued inclines- and thus less risk- are a bit thin on the ground. 
Your ascent to the B'schießer delivers spectacular views across the valley to the Großer Daumen and the peaks that make up the Hohe Gänge. From B'shießer itself you will be able to see across to the Schrecksee, the Gaishorn, and beyond. 
Snow conditions on the day will dictate whether you'll want to put on pair of trail spikes, snowshoes, or just your boots. We made a point of taking everything just in case. 
You might like to also check out my other winter route that takes you up the nearby Rohnenspitze: Climbing the Rohnenspitze in winter (1,990 m), Tannheimer Tal

images.caption: The last section is pretty open and easy

title: Alpine pasture hike to Bocchetta di Doia
short_description: On a circular hike in the wild Val Vergeletto, the former valley of the straw weavers, we discover forgotten alpine pastures and enjoy the magnificent view of the Maggia valley at the Bocchetta di Doia.
long_description: This lonely circular tour takes us from Vergeletto, the last village in the valley of the same name, up to quiet, long abandoned mountain pastures. Along the traces of past mountain farming, we hike high above the wild valley, criss-crossed by gorges and ravines, to the 2000 m high Bocchetta di Doia, a saddle that also represents a passage from the Onsernone to the Maggia valley. Here we enjoy magnificent views. We return to Vergeletto via the Fagna and Camana valleys.

images.caption: View from the mountain village of Gresso into the Val Onsernone.

title: Circular hike on Comino
short_description: Circular hiking trail on the Maltese archipelago – on the way on a natural jewel with only a few inhabitants
long_description: The island of Comino invites you to stay, that's for sure. The Blue Lagoon alone enchants visitors to the small island with its crystal clear and azure blue water. Provided we can enjoy it at the time when there are not many tourist boats on the island. Parts of the small island resemble a lunar landscape, surrounded by crater-like holes that the sea inevitably eats into the rock. The landscape of the smallest inhabited island in the Maltese archipelago, which was a prison island several hundred years ago, is second to none.

title: Bohusleden - Section 17 - Nornäs to Vassbotten
short_description: The seventeenth stage of the Bohusleden runs along the Norwegian border from Nornäs by Lake Mellan Kornsjön to Vassbotten.
long_description: The tour starts on the shore of Norra Kornsjön, and offers a beautiful view of the small islands of the lake right at the beginning. As the tour progresses, we hike in very hilly terrain along the Swedish-Norwegian border.

title: Two monasteries and a challenging walk: Sihla - Sihăstria
short_description: Hiking between the monasteries and hermitages in the Vânători Neamț Natural Park is recommended both to enjoy the most charming things this little-promoted protected area has to offer, as well as for exercise or to vary a program that only includes monastery visits. This route goes from Sihla to Sihăstria, returning via the Daniil Sihastrul Hermitage.
long_description:
Sihla and Sihăstria monasteries are among the most important in the county; and the monastery complexes are very beautiful, well maintained, and ready to receive pilgrims. The forest road that connects them to Agapia Monastery favors covering the distance by car.
That is why the main and most interesting part of the route is the path marked with a blue cross between Sihla and Sihăstria monasteries, where cars do not have access. The route takes you through refreshing and calming forests and is a great opportunity to meditate, enjoy nature and complete tranquility. This path avoids the dusty forest that cars or bicycles follow to cover the distance between the two churches. In addition, it is followed only by pilgrims, possibly by monks. Very likely, the road was crossed by the great priests from the monasteries here.
At the Daniil Sihastrul Hermitage, on the other hand, fewer people arrive, because you have to go up on foot. If you choose this route to return, you will discover a wilder and more captivating nature than on the main path.

images.caption: Church made from one single tree, Sihla

title: Circuit of the Gouffre de l'Oeil Doux
short_description: Starting out from Fleury, in the commune of Saint-Pierre-la-Mer, this circular walk offers an opportunity to discover the unspoilt nature of the Gulf of Lion, in the heart of the Narbonnaise en Méditerranée Regional Nature Park.
long_description: The route guides you along dirt paths to the Gouffre de l'Oeil Doux, characterised by its imposing limestone cliffs covered in greenery, overlooking an emerald-green expanse of water.

title: Walk to the 3 waterfalls
short_description: This hike allows you to discover three emblematic waterfalls of Le Mont-Dore located quite close to each other. A "refreshing" walk in the heart of the Puy-de-Dôme and the Auvergne!
long_description:
The start is here next to the Tourist Office of Le Mont-Dore (you can also shorten the route by starting the walk directly after the Esquiladou campsite). The first two kilometres are on pavements and lightly trafficked roads to the landscaped cemetery. From here you take a groomed route for a few metres before taking more pleasant paths and tracks for walking.
Your first objective: to reach the Saut du Loup waterfall. The route climbs before skirting the Domaine de la Louve Blanche where Alpages are raised in particular. Curious! You then find yourself on the edge of the D996. Cross the road carefully at this point (bend). The last few metres lead you to the foot of the waterfall, the flow of which can be more or less important depending on the time of year.
.
Now retrace your steps, towards the Queureuilh waterfall! At the first crossroads (km 5.4), the sound of the waterfalls quickly directs you to the path leading to this second waterfall, which is as impressive if not more so than the first.
The thick foliage of the forest invites you to continue your hike through this cool, shady environment. Cross a bridge and reach the last waterfall: that of the Rossignolet! Smaller in height, it is no less pretty. It is also different from the others. The place is ideal for a moment of rest and relaxation... Take a break there before finishing this loop!
You return to the village of Le Mont-Dore by the same route you took on the outward journey.

title: Suçuarana Trail in the Cantareira State Park
short_description: This beautiful trail connects two levels of the Cantareira State Park, Águas Claras and Pedra Grande, in São Paulo.
long_description:
The trail of Suçuarana é a good option for those who wish to reach the beautiful natural viewpoint of the Pedra Grande, from where you have a privileged panoramic view of the city of São Paulo in the middle of an incredible and preserved area of Atlantic Forest. This trail is well signposted and less strenuous than the path that begins at the Pedra Grande site. The trail suggested here is 7.5 km long, because it is worth stopping off at Lago das Carpas (Carp Lake). The place is very beautiful and also has picnic tables, resting areas and a playground for children.
The Ácleo Águas Claras was opened for visits in 2000 and helps to protect an important springs area in the region. Cantareira State Park is divided into four levels and was inaugurated in 1963. In 1994, it was declared part of the Green Belt Biosphere Reserve of the city of São Paulo by UNESCO.

title: Visiting the isolated settlements in Cernei Mountains & Arjana Peak
short_description: A multi-day tour that reveals all that the Cerna Mountains have to offer: isolated settlements, dreamy landscapes, welcoming people, meadows, and fresh air.
long_description:
From the very beginning, the route reveals its peculiarities: an abandoned water mill, charming forests at the end of which fairytale views open up, isolated houses. After a few hours' hike, we found the ideal place to stop and admire the panorama - the gazebo at the end of Dobraia village.
The path continued along the edge of the village, an opportunity to admire the few houses. Also from here, you can see the Prislop pass, your targeted direction. We camped over there.
From the pass, the path we took from Dobraia is quite visible. From here, we climbed towards the Arjana Peak.
The next day, we continued on the ridge of Cerna Mountains, an exposed, windy segment. Marking in this area is done with little stone pyramids, especially on the higher peaks. If the weather is sunny, the view opens to the Cerna Valley, on one side, and to the Tarcu Mountains, on the other.
From the Ciumerna pass, we descended steeply towards Ineleț village. It's a shame to avoid the households here, where the locals have something to offer (brandy, cheese, eggs, milk, pickles, hot meals) - you can see plates with whatever they sell.
The last segment of the road, the descent to the main road, takes the wooden stairs that have become a real tourist attraction in recent years.
