title: From Ipthausen to Eyershausen
short_description: A beautiful hike through woods and meadows with visits to two church buildings awaits us on this tour through the Grabfeld near Bad Königshofen.
long_description: We choose the spa centre in Bad Königshofen as the starting point for our hike. We walk down the road, leaving the "Franken Care" care centre on the right. At the crossroads we come across our first tour marker, the "unfilled green triangle on a white background". We turn right onto the atmospheric birch avenue and walk past the beautifully situated Kneuersee, where we can also stop for a while. On the avenue we find some beautiful wayside shrines and can also use the well-trodden path next to the tarred track for hiking. Crossing a small stream, we soon reach the pilgrimage church Maria Geburt, which was built in rococo style, and hike past it on the right. A footpath leads us across the Weißbach stream into Ipthausen. In the centre of the village we find the village museum and walk past it. Immediately we turn left and walk past the country inn to a stone crucifix. Here we find a signpost pointing us to the Merklach mountain hut. We use the right-hand path to the Blankenberg farm, which leads us slightly uphill. We walk past a poultry farm and cross a forest road. Then, after a bend to the right, we walk left into the forest. We are now in the eastern part of the Grabfeld, which was rightly included in the nature park because of its interspersed hills and forests. We now hike a short distance through the Hainholz and reach a clearing. Here we can turn right. This takes us across a meadow to the mountain hut at the highest point of the Blankenberg. Here we can take a first rest under fruit trees and enjoy the beautiful view. We then walk down again and return to the path. This leads us across the clearing back into the forest. Partly through open, hedge-rich landscape with beautiful views, partly through forest, the hike now leads us further through the Grabfeld. The path climbs slightly and we reach an open field, where we walk along the edge of the forest on the right and bypass it. At the edge of the field we discover a signpost pointing us back into the forest. It goes uphill and we reach a small clearing in the "Merklach" forest. Here there is a bench with a bank book, where we can immortalise ourselves with a meaningful saying. It is also worth stopping here, as the view of the southern part of the Grabfeld is beautiful. We have now reached the highest point of our tour and hike back down. After a bend to the right, we come to a forest path. Here we walk to the left and discover a seating area at the forest clearing. Here we can take another rest. The view extends over Eyershausen to the Kleiner and Großer Gleichberg mountains in the north. We now walk downhill along the path through the fields and turn right at a crossroads. We reach Eyershausen via the Weißbach stream and walk past the village pond. Here we also find the trail marking that accompanies us on the last part of our hike, the blue "X" on a white background. Cross the main road to reach the village church, considered one of the most beautiful in Lower Franconia. Shortly before the village sign, we turn left into the meadow path and cross the Krummengraben. We come to a cycle path and turn right. The path now leads us back along the Weißbach on partly poplar-lined paths. At a bench we leave the Weißbach and walk across an open field to Ipthausen. We reach the crucifix again and walk past the village fountain to the pilgrimage church. Via Birkenallee we reach the spa centre again and this time we can turn right over a small bridge beforehand. This way we reach the car park again via the caravan parks and have reached the destination of our hike.

images.caption: The resting bench offers a beautiful view as far as the Gleichberge mountains to the north.
The grave field near Ipthausen is very scenic.
The pilgrimage church Maria Geburt was built around 1746 in place of an older church.
Eyershausen was mentioned in documents as early as 799.

title: From Niederstetten to Mörike's Memorial Room
short_description: Up and down we go through the stream and meadow landscape near Niederstetten. Along the way we pass the former home of the poet Eduard Mörike.
long_description: The Rehhofsteige, where our starting point is located, takes us in a curve out of Niederstetten. At the last houses of the village, the trail branches off to the left and leads to the Regenbach valley. We follow this in an arc through the meadow landscape and, shortly after our path joins another, turn left onto a field path in a northerly direction. We walk through fields, always following the path, until we come to a four-way intersection. There we turn left and after a few metres cross the meadow onto the parallel path that runs to our left. Walk along the slope of the Steinbach stream until you reach Vorbachzimmern. After crossing the village, we turn left at the edge of the village into Lüttlingsbergstraße, keep to the right at the next fork and stay on this path until we reach a trail star after a right-hand bend. Here we take the second path from the left, which leads us through a piece of forest past the small village of Ebertsbronn. Shortly before entering Ebertsbronn, turn right onto the path to Wermutshausen. Along the stream we enter the village where the poet Eduard Mörike lived with his friend Pastor Wilhelm Hartlaub from September 1843 to April 1844. In addition to the Mörike memorial, Wermutshausen also has a wine press and viticulture museum. Via the Rehhofsteige and the farmstead of the same name, we now return to our starting point in Niederstetten.

title: Rotensohl circular trail near Heidenheim
short_description: This medium circular trail with a longer ascent leads from Rotensohl to Großkuchen, Kleinkuchen and back.
long_description:
From the car park at the Waldhorn restaurant, our path leads approx. 100 m in the direction of Nietheim, then off to the right via Mittlere Gemeinde to Großkuchen. The baroque St. Peter and Paul Church in Großkuchen can still be seen largely in its original state. We walk along Neresheimer Straße to the end of the village. At the crossroads we turn right, after about 50 m left into the field path (Auernheimer Weg), which takes us to Kleinkuchen. The St. Ulrich Church in Kleinkuchen was built in the first half of the 18th century.
We turn into Fuhrgasse and follow the path into the forest. At the third possibility we turn right. Not far from our path, on the right in the forest, is the Celtic Quadrilateral Enclosure, an enclosed prehistoric cult site.
We stay on the path until it meets the Schnaitheim hiking trail. Here we turn right back to Rotensohl.

title: Refugee Route - Historic multi-day walking route
short_description: The tour is a historical hike and a collaboration between DNT and Riksantikvaren. The collaboration makes old roads better known and more used. These tours offer great outdoor experiences and unique cultural heritage.
long_description:
Flyktningeruta is a 12 mile long signposted route that follows a route that was used by couriers and refugees who wanted to get to safety in Sweden during World War II.
The tour is about 120 km long. The terrain is quite demanding with many ups and downs. Several of the stages are without overnight accommodation and you must therefore bring a tent or sleep under the open sky. Accommodation is provided at Amundseter and Steinby. The tour has stretches that require a boat as well as stretches that are on the road. I divide the trip into 5 parts in this description.

title: Bohusleden - Section 19 - Håvedalen to Björneröd
short_description: The nineteenth stage of Bohusleden leads from Håvedalen to Björneröd.
long_description: Today's trail runs through an idyllic forest landscape along the old customs road. After the dissolution of the Union of Sweden and Norway in 1905, the border between the two countries was guarded until the end of the Second World War;

title: Brașov (Solomon) - Postăvaru cabin - Poiana Brașov
short_description: One of the classic routes around Brașov; it goes along well-trodden paths by many hikers and even cyclists. It is also known as the "Yellow Road".
long_description:
The paths that start from the end of the Schei neighborhood in Brașov generally lead to Poiana Brașov and Postăvaru Peak. These are mostly wide and well-organized forest paths. Although they are not marked for cyclists, many mountain bikers come here, following the mountain signs just like hikers.
This route, starting at Pietrele lui Solomon and reaching Postăvaru cabin welcomes almost everyone. It comes with only a few steep, sometimes demanding parts, through deciduous forests that gradually become coniferous. In fact, the landscape is mostly dominated by forests. Towards the end, in Poiana Ruia, the view opens as a reward to Poiana Brașov and Măgura Codlei. For an even greater reward, you must reach the Postavaru Chalet (Julius Römer Hütte). Here, on sunny days, you can see far away - towards the beautiful ridges of Bucegi and Piatra Craiului.
The descent is mostly pleasurable, a little steep in from place to place. To your front, you see only the roofs of the hotels in Poiana Brașov.

images.caption: Piatra Mare seen from Postavaru cabin

title: Dermbacher Hochrhönweg
short_description: We hike from Dermbach on the Hochrhönweg to the Gläserberg. From there we walk via Föhlritz down to the Probstei Zella.
long_description: We start at the market square in Dermbach and walk to the right through the market street and Karl-Friedrich-Straße. The street "Am Stein" leads us to a forest path, which we follow to the "Hirtentränke", the former Dermbach market fountain. We continue uphill in the direction of Gläserberg. Shortly after the information board "Basaltintrusion am Gläser", we reach the turn-off to the right that leads us to the Gläserberg lookout point. From here we descend to Föhlritz. From there, we take the hardly used road into the valley and pass a large wayside cross as well as the turnoff to the woodcarving village of Empfertshausen. The end point of our tour is the Probstei Zella. In front of it is the small bus station, from where a bus takes us back to Dermbach. Alternatively, you can take the same route back.

images.caption: The Probstei in Zella marks the end of our hike.
From Dermbach's market square we walk towards the Luther lime tree and the baroque Protestant church
The two adjoining churches in Dermbach should definitely be visited.
The village of Dermbach looks back on almost 900 years of history.

title: Walk in Robion on the heights and at the foot of the Luberon massif
short_description: Here is a short hike without major difficulty to discover much more than the historic village of Robion. A nature getaway well known by the locals!
long_description:
We start this walk all uphill... From the very first meters, be curious, turn around! The Mont-Ventoux points the tip of its nose from the first steps towards the Boulon. 
You will then easily access a rather narrow path to reach the highest point of this walk and thus contemplate the view over Cavaillon, Les Taillades and the Monts de Vaucluse! The place is ideal for a picnic break for example in the respect of this preserved space.
The descent allows you then to enjoy the view of Cavaillon, Les Taillades and the Monts de Vaucluse.
The descent then allows you to reach the banks of the Boulon river, close to its source. Along the way, you will pass cedar and olive trees with the Luberon massif in the background. The walk continues like this before reaching the village of Robion by a small road.
The walk is a short one.

images.caption: Path taken before the ascent of the Luberon massif
View of the Saint-Jacques hill - Cavaillon
Vineyards at the foot of the Luberon
randonnée dans les Alpes: Balade à Robion sur les hauteurs et au pied dans le Luberon

title: Hiking route from the suspension bridge near the village of Forchach to Lake Siegel (Forchach-Siegelsee)
short_description: A hiking route from the suspension bridge over the Lech river near the village of Forchach in Tyrol to Lake Sieglsee.
long_description: A lovely hiking route that begins with a walk on a wooden suspension bridge near the village of Forchach and continues on a moderate to medium elevation to a lake with a gorgeous turquoise color. You can walk the route according to your ability as much as you want and at any given moment turn around and retrace the steps. The road is mostly shaded and very comfortable for walking, the entire length of the road has a panoramic view of the Alps. Along the way you pass streams, waterfalls and small ponds.

title: Around Juist
short_description: On this extended circular walk we experience all facets of the island of Juist.
long_description:
The East Frisian island of Juist on the tidal flats of the North Sea is only 17 km long and in many places only 500 m wide. Motor vehicles are almost exclusively prohibited on the island, so hiking and cycling here can be a particularly relaxing experience.
On this extended tour, we walk once completely around the island and see the most important highlights of Juist. We start at the harbour with its new sea mark and the newly built sports boat harbour. Then we pass through Loog, the second village on the island. Hammersee and "Bill" are the next destinations, after which we walk along the beach almost its entire length from east to west. At the other end, the island's small airfield awaits us - and we're already heading back to the harbour.

images.caption: The North Sea beach on Juist.

title: Immenstadt - Wertach
short_description: On an extended hike from Immenstadt to Wertach, we explore the most diverse landscapes of the Allgäu. Again and again, there are far-reaching views into the foothills of the Alps.
long_description: First we cross the Illertal valley from Immenstadt to Rettenberg. Then we climb via Alpe Kammeregg up to the Grüntenhütte on the prominent summit ridge of the Grünten. From here we descend into the Great Forest.  We leave the forest area up to the Alpe Schnitzlertal below the Wertacher Hörnle. Now the transition to the slopes of the Wertach valley takes place. We descend to the Wertach. On the Seebaldweg we reach the market town of Wertach. From the town hall there are buses to Oy-Mittelberg, or via Oberjoch and Bad Hindelang to Sonthofen. The further return journey is then again by regional trains.

images.caption: Play station in the hare garden
Hut at the Alpe Vordere Kollegen

title: From Erdweg to Alto's Minster
short_description: Passing churches of different centuries, we walk from Erdweg through the Dachau hinterland to Altomünster.
long_description: From the station we walk to the main road and follow it to the right until Eisenhofen. There we walk across the "Unterer Petersberg" car park and up the footpath to Petersberg (1). On the other side it leads us downhill again. At the bottom we turn left twice and enter Schleifmühlstraße. It leads us to Kleinberghofen (2), where we continue on the other side of the tracks. Behind the village we turn left. In Unterzeitlbach (3) we choose the Mantelbergstraße. Now we first keep right, then left and leave the village. In Stumpfenbach we cross the railway tracks and at the chapel of St. Ulrich (4) we turn into Kapellenstraße. It leads into a field path to Altomünster (5). From the station down by the stream, we take the S-Bahn back to Erdweg.

images.caption: The townscape of Altomünster is characterised by the monastery church.
The Romanesque basilica on Petersberg is one of the oldest buildings in the diocese of Munich-Freising.
The parish church of St. Martin in Kleinberghofen dates from the end of the 12th century and contains baroque frescoes inside.
Next to the chapel of St. Sebastian, there are benches for resting and a fountain with a statue of St. Anthony.
The market fountain from 1878 is fed with water from the Alto spring.
The idyllic valley of the Zeitlbach.

title: De Meinweg hiking trail
short_description: This route runs through the Meinweg national park. The route takes about 4.5 hours.
long_description: National Park De Meinweg is a beautiful nature reserve located for the most part in the Netherlands. A small but beautiful part of the park lies in Belgiumë. The national park consists of four different terraces. It is a beautiful terraced landscape that was created during the last ice age. Apart from the natural differences in height, there is much more beauty to be found in the area. For instance, you will find beautiful fens, streams and forests.

images.caption: Small pond in De Meinweg national park

title: Bischofsgrüner Heilklima-Runde 1
short_description: A nice little loop to the meadows and forests of Bischofsgrün.
long_description: Short circular trail with ascents totalling about 70 metres in altitude to the Bischofsgrün meadows and forests.

images.caption: We can linger under a tree and enjoy nature.

title: Adriatic Highway
short_description: Get a sense of unlimited freedom at the stunning Adriatic coastline. On its way southwards it passes coastal cities as well as picturesque nature parks.
long_description:
Beautiful landscapes and a breathtaking coastal panorama, as far as the eye can see – that’s what Adriatic Highway is all about. Formerly known as Yugoslav coastal street, it’s a pleasure for nature lovers and passionate drivers alike.  You’ll find picturesque seaside towns next to authentic fishing villages with a lot of history on their backs. Fascinating cities such as Biograd na Moru and Split have an exciting history to share. You’ll even get to see the massive Velebit mountain range right next to the highway. From there you can enjoy unique views of Adriatic coastline.
Adriatic Highway winds its way along the coastline for about 375 miles from Rijeka to Dubrovnik. Leading from Croatia to Montenegro, it covers even parts of Sloweniea and Bosnia. Over the years it has been restructured and extended, that‘s why there isn’t just one way to go. You can extend it as you like, according to your preferences and following your own rhythm.
But be careful: Adriatic Highway is pretty curvy, so mind the speed limit and drive carefully.

images.caption: At Split you can find several historical buildings.
Blick auf das Velebit-Massiv bei Paklenica
Bay of Lavsa, part of the vast Kornati national park
City center and port of Dubrovnic

title: Hiking trail Kalmthoutse heide (Belgium)
short_description: The Kalmhoutse heide is a real border park. It runs through the Netherlands and Belgiumë. During this route you walk most of the time through België. The route is 18 kilometres long and takes about 4.5 hours.
long_description:
In this border park, you can unwind. In fact, the area is one of the quietest areas in the Netherlands and Belgium. During your walk you will discover different pieces of nature. You will walk through forests, heathland, sand drifts and along small fens.
.

title: Winter hike to Măgura Codlei Peak, via Poiana Ruseț
short_description: There are two options to reach Măgura Codlei peak from the northern side - going around the mountain, through the forest (blue cross marking), or a straight climb (red dot marking). Given the winter conditions, I chose the first option, which is also the recommended one. Although recommended as low difficulty (on the signposts), the climb proved to be challenging due to the untrodden snow, at least in the second half.
long_description:
The route begins as a romantic path, along the Codlea pool and lakes. At the end of the pool, there is the first signpost, which marks the beginning of the “dry weather” route (red dot) - this would be the most direct path to the top of Măgura Codlei. However, as the route has rocky and possibly slippery, I avoided it.
I continued on the path that runs parallel to one of the lakes, following the yellow dot marking. A blue stripe mark can also be seen; at some point, it will stay on the right, while the yellow dot route begins to climb slightly up through the deciduous forest.
Not long after, you reach the intersection with the forest road that comes from your right, and is marked for mountain biking as well; this is where the blue cross marking begins, and it continues all the way to the top.
Following the wide forest road, I passed an area with cut logs - the locals must also come here with their carts, for wood supply. You pass an old stone quarry, and after about 1.5km you reach Poiana Ruseț.
Here you can stop for a meal or just for pictures. A little above the clearing you reach a new intersection, with a signpost. It should be about 1 hour and 20 minutes to the top...
Now, in the winter, the path was trodden and wide only up till this point. No one had passed upwards beside the forest animals. So I cleared my own path. At first, the snow was quite light and the climb was acceptable. The very frequent and visible markings gave me an idea of the winding direction of the path. About 15 minutes after the intersection, the heavy climb began. The snow got deeper, hiding slippery boulders or tree roots. Of course, all this is visible in dry weather and easy to get around or avoid. For the untrained hiker or the children, this part can be a problem in winter - both when going up and down.
After a considerable effort, I reached the last signpost - practically the main ridge of Magură Codlei; from here, it takes about 20-30 minutes to reach the top, on an even steeper relief, but somewhat more practicable.
Normally, I would have chosen to return in a circuit, on the red dot, but the relief was dangerous. And as I saw in the beginning (from the end of the pool), no one had passed on this patch before, so I chose the return on the same route.

images.caption: The former stone quarry at the base of Măgura Codlei
The last signpost; 20 more minutes to the Măgura Codlei peak

title: Winter - Circular hike Alpe Stubental - Obere Reuterwanne - Jungholz
short_description: A winter circular hike with great views, characterised by nature, via the Alpe Stubental to the Obere Alpe Reuterwanne through the Austrian enclave of Jungholz.
long_description:
This medium-difficulty, nature-balanced, winter circular hike takes us across traditional alps to wonderful vantage points that put the far-reaching Allgäu and Tyrolean Alps in the spotlight. Continuously signposted paths lead us on our circular walk to the desired destinations.
  Enjoy peace, nature and tradition to the fullest!

images.caption: View of Jungholz's local mountain Sorgschrofen

title: Snowshoeing to Fatos Hut - Hayla peak
short_description: Hayla is a special mountain in the Accursed Mountains. In winter, when the hard ridges of the mountain are covered with snow, the huge face of Halay appears even quite friendly.
long_description: The route to Hayla Peak is a popular hike for both local people and tourists in both summer and winter. We hiked together with the Gjeravica Association for the annual ascent in the first two weeks of January. After Pepaj from Peja, the cars started. From there we walked 2 hours up to Fatos hut, which is at the foot of Hayla. The next morning we climbed Hayla Peak through fresh snow and enjoyed the unending views to Montenegro to the east, the Accursed Mountains to the west and the Shar Mountains to the south west.

title: Bohusleden - Stage 5 - Fontin to Grandalen
short_description: The fifth stage of the Bohusleden leads from the Fontin nature reserve to Grandalen.
long_description: Fontin is an idyllic nature reserve in the municipality of Kungälv. Passing the small lake Svarte Mosse, the trail leads through several forest sections and hilly pastureland. This section of the trail is a little more challenging than the previous ones due to the hilly terrain. We also expect to climb Aleklätten (134 m), from where we have a good panoramic view, and visit Mariebergs Herrgård, a country estate with a beautiful garden.

title: Walking from Marlow into the Recknitz Valley
short_description: We walk from the beautiful town of Marlow into the romantic Recknitz valley. This enjoyable tour surprises us with a highlight at the turning point.
long_description: We walk to the right into Buchenweg. This leads into Stralsunder Straße, which we follow uphill to the right. Turn left into Alte Burgstraße. When this bends to the right, we continue straight ahead on a path that leads us out of the village. We follow the path downhill to the left. At the next crossroads, keep to the right. The concrete slab path leads us beautifully through the Recknitz valley (1), with extensive cattle pastures stretching towards the river. Shortly after the beginning of a forest on the right side of the path, we see a marker of the "Tour der Steine" on the right side. At this point we follow the path leading to the right into the forest. At the following crossroads in this lovely little wood (2), we continue straight on, at the T-junction at the edge of the wood we walk to the left. At the two following forks, we choose the right-hand variant in each case. The path leads us along the edge of the forest and bends to the left. Soon a path branches off to the left to the easily recognisable Burgwall (3). A Slavic castle stood here between the 9th and 11th centuries. This place was one of the hideouts of the legendary buccaneer captain Klaus Störtebeker. At the foot of the castle rampart, a beautiful rest area invites you to take a breather. After visiting the remains of the castle, we return to the path running along the edge of the forest and follow it to the left. When you reach the familiar concrete slab path, you will see another rest area (4) and an information board about the castle wall. Follow the concrete slab path to the left in the direction of Marlow and walk back to the starting point via Stralsunder Straße and Buchenweg.

images.caption: At the foot of the castle rampart, an original rest area invites us to take a break.
We walk through an idyllic little forest.
The basic features of the Slavic rampart are still clearly recognisable today.
Again and again we can enjoy charming views.
Extensive cattle pastures extend into the Recknitz valley.

title: Bischofsgrüner Heilklima-Runde 5
short_description: Past the landscape garden, the cemetery of honour and over the Kroppenbach we walk on a nice loop in the north-east of Bischofsgrün.
long_description:
The requirements due to the path are to be classified as low.
It is a short circular path (1.7 km) with only a small difference in altitude of approx. 30 metres and a low gradient.
The average energy consumption for a body weight of 75 kg is approx. 90 kcal.
We walk mainly on a path protected from the sun and wind through the forest.

images.caption: We find good signposting on all paths in Bischofsgrün.

title: Sentiero delle Foreste Sacre
short_description: The cycle route runs for a total of around 88 km through the Parco Nazionale delle Foreste Casentinesi National Park to the province of Forlì-Cesena in Emilia-Romagna. The hilly terrain opens up fascinating views of the mountain world of the Apennines.
long_description: The tour begins directly at the Lago di Ponte river and leads over the Colle del Tramazzo mountain pass (971 m). The itinerary then goes through the hamlet of San Benedetto in Alpe in the village of Portico e San Benedetto to the famous waterfall Cascata dell’Acquacheta, described in Dante's Divine Comedy. Via Castagno d’Andrea, the birthplace of the painter Andrea del Castagno, the route continues uphill to Monte Falco, which towers over the national park at an impressive 1650 m above sea level. A little further south is the Camaldolese monastery. The rest of the tour offers impressive panoramic views of the monastery. Via the mountain pass Passo dei Fangacci in the Tuscan Apennines and the no less impressive Poggio allo Spillo (1438 m), the route runs past Monte Penna (1289 m) to the Precipizio de La Verna and the neighbouring Franciscan monastery of La Verna.

images.caption: In aller Abgeschiedenheit - das Kloster von Camaldoli.

title: Jostal-Runde near Waldau in the Upper Black Forest
short_description: The Jostaltour is a beautiful Nordic walking tour with magnificent views of the Black Forest heights, the Jostal valley and the Langenordnachtal valley.
long_description: The tour begins in the Alte Mühlenstraße. From the end of the village, we walk to the edge of the forest (yellow rhombus on a white background), then straight up to the Kaiserkreuz (1). We continue walking straight ahead. On the right, the path leads us to a clearing, here we turn right. Following the signs to the Schweizerhof, we finally turn left. Past the Schwörershof farm (2), we walk along the Jostalstraße to the right and shortly afterwards left again, following a path into the forest. At the Kreuz inn, we cross the B500 and briefly follow the Westweg to the left over the "Hohlen Graben (3)" and meet the B500 again, which we cross again at the "Süßen Häusle (4)". Keep to the right, follow the Westweg for a few more metres and leave it into the forest. Above the Doldenhof (5), we descend to Oberjostal. Behind the Josen inn, the path leads into the Schnattertal (6) and up the Schneeberg; we follow the yellow rhombus. At the top, we turn left onto a forest path. A little later we follow the signs to the left back to Waldau.

images.caption: The Kaiserkreuz is the stage destination of our tour.
This is the view from the Hohlen Graben.
Place to rest at the fish pond.
View of the Jostal - in the foreground the Schwörerhof.
View of Waldau from the water treading facility.

title: The forest and its secrets around Rohrbach
short_description: On this easy Nordic walking tour we can get to know and enjoy the flora and fauna around the picturesque Eginger See (Rohrbachsee).
long_description: We start our tour at the lakeside car park in Rohrbach. From here we continue on the themed hiking trail "From the forest and its secrets". We always follow the red and white route "1". Passing the tree telephone as well as the wooden organ and the "Gipfelblick" station, we finally reach the "Wurzelwelten" (Root Worlds). Shortly afterwards, we come to the northern tip of Lake Egingen. We cross the Rohrbach and follow the route "1" along the lake to the Sonnen-Therme. Finally, we circle the area of the swimming pool at the lake and reach the pedal boat rental shortly before our destination. In the nearby Seehof restaurant, we can fortify ourselves a little at the end.

images.caption: The tree telephone and the wooden organ.
The pedal boat rental at Lake Egingen.

title: Walking route Oostvaardersplassen
short_description: This route runs through the new land and is about 5.5 kilometres long.
long_description: Located on the edge of Flevoland, the New Land is a newly created piece of land. It is the youngest nature park in the Netherlands and you can enjoy hiking.

title: Circuit des bords de Loire
short_description:
Sur les rives de la Loire, à proximité du château de Chambord, Saint-Claude-de-Diray vous séduira par ses multiples attraits. Avec son patrimoine naturel, sa gastronomie et son petit patrimoine, la commune a beaucoup à offrir.
Translate to English
long_description:
La gastronomie occupe une place importante à Saint-Claude-de-Diray, avec la culture de l'igname, un légume emblématique, ainsi que l'asperge et la viticulture. En quittant le bourg, vous longerez des vignobles de l'aire de production de l'AOC Cheverny, avant de rejoindre les rives de la Loire, d'où vous pourrez admirer le château de Ménars sur l'autre rive.
En revenant vers le bourg, vous passerez près du hameau de Nozieux, où se trouvent les vestiges d'un château qui fut la propriété de la Marquise de Pompadour pendant quatre ans.
En chemin, vous pourrez également apercevoir de nombreux puits, une quarantaine en tout, dispersés sur la commune. Avant de partir, n'oubliez pas de visiter l'église Saint-Claude et d'explorer les fonts baptismaux datant du XVIIe siècle.
Translate to English

title: ताबो गोम्पा और ताबो गुफाओं का ट्रैक
short_description: हिमाचल प्रदेश के लाहौल और स्पीति ज़िले का यह अनछुआ ट्र ैक, ताबो नाम के एक छोटे से कस्बे में स्थित ताबो गोम्पा से होते हुए पास की प्राचीन प्राकृ तिक बौद्ध गुफाओं तक जाता है।
long_description:
स्पीति नदी के किनारे और राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग 505 के पास बसे ताबो गाँव में प्रसिद्ध ताबो गोम्पा या ताबो मठ हैं। ताबो मठ की स्थापना करीब एक हज़ार साल पहले 996 ईस्वी में हुई थी। आज कई शताब्दियों से ताबो मठ तिब्बती बौद्धधर्म का सबसे प्राचीन एवं महत्वपूर्ण केंद्र है। ताबो गोम्पा से कुछ ही दूरी पर हाईवे के पार दूसरी तरफ कई प्राकृतिक गुफाएँ देखी जा सकती हैं जिन्हें ताबो गुफाएँ कहते हैं। यह गुफाएँ शायद पुराने बौद्ध भिक्षुओं ने चट्टानों को खोखला कर के बनाई थीं। ऐसा माना जाता है की इनको प्राचीन काल में किसी समय पर आवास के रूप में इस्तेमाल किया गया था। आजकल इन गुफाओं का उपयोग शायद ही कभी किया जाता है, लेकिन आपको ट्रैकिंग के दौरान अगर किसी गुफा के बाहर फहराता झंडा दिखें तो समझ जाएँ की कोई बौद्ध भिक्षुक उस गुफ़ा में ध्यान करने आया है। भूल कर भी उस गुफ़ा के अंदर ना जाएँ और ट्रैकिंग के दौरान शोरगुल भी न करें।   
ताबो मठ और गुफाओं का ट्रैक आसान और आनंददायक है। यह शहरी दौरे और नेचर ट्रैक दोनों का मिला जुला रूप है।  जहाँ एक ओर गोम्पा जाने के लिए बस्ती से होकर गुजरना पड़ता है, वहीं दूसरी ओर गुफाओं तक जाने के लिए पहाड़ी पगडण्डी पर चलना पड़ता है। ट्रैक पूरा करने के बाद ताबो शहर के रेस्त्रां में असली पारम्परिक तिब्बती व्यंजन भी ज़रूर आजमाने चाहिए।

title: Blue route near Inzell
short_description: This round takes us on an easy route near Inzell. The 3.6 km long loop is ideally suited for anyone who wants to familiarise themselves with the sport of Nordic Walking.
long_description: We follow the blue sign with white direction arrow; a footpath that leads into Ahornstraße. Now we go straight on the road towards Brenner. In the hamlet of Brenner (1) we turn left at the T-junction. At the next fork, we keep left and turn right at the junction towards Schwarzberg and Gschwall. At the next farmstead, turn left towards the centre of Schwarzberg (2) and Unterrain. Via the Weißenweg we reach the B306. Follow this to the left. Shortly afterwards we turn left in the direction of Reith. At the T-junction we walk to the right. At the corner of Lärchenstraße/Kreuzfeldstraße, a bench (3) with a view of the Hochstaufen invites us to take a break. We continue along Lärchenstraße back to the starting point.

images.caption: Meadows and mountains as far as the eye can see.
The footpath at the beginning of our walking tour.

title: Walking Bad Neuhaus
short_description: This medium-difficulty Nordic walking trail takes us via the spa gardens in Bad Neuhaus up to the Salzburg and back down to the valley on winding paths.
long_description: From the car park we walk a short distance along the railway tracks, cross under them and reach the spa gardens (1). We then walk a loop around the lake past the spa buildings to the castle chapel. Here we walk out of the park and up into the forest. At the edge of the forest, a path joins the road. We turn left here and reach the Salzburg (2). We can take a break in the castle tavern in the courtyard. Continue along the ridge to the pulse measuring station (3). We reach the edge of the forest, turn right and cross a meadow to reach the road. Follow the road down to a fork to the left. We now walk along a path to Mühlbach, pass the Kneipp basin (4) and reach the car park again via a crossroads.

images.caption: Our Nordic Walking Trail goes downhill again across this meadow.

title: Bischofsgrüner Heilklima-Runde 4
short_description: A medium, varied tour through the fabulous Fichtelgebirge.
long_description:
The requirements due to the trail are classified as medium. It is a long circular trail (10.1 km) with ascents totalling about 220 metres in altitude. In the process, we overcome predominantly low and only occasionally moderate gradients. Our average energy consumption is about 570 kcal for a weight of 75 kg.

The requirements due to the climate can also be classified as medium. The trail is varied and has, on the one hand, stimulus-intensive sections that lead across the fields of Bischofsgrün, Birnstengel and especially Wülfersreuth, and, on the other hand, stimulus-mild sections that run through the villages or in the protection of the forest.
In summer, thermal conditions are predominantly comfortable to cool. In winter, cold stimuli are often to be expected.
In the "place of power" one can find the way to inner harmony and physical and mental balance through deep relaxation and tranquillity. The special powers of this place were discovered in May 1996 by the radiation seeker Lothar Meinhardt from Kempten.

title: Running circuit: Vichy - from the casino to the banks of the Allier
short_description: A short distance to cover the majesty of the Palais des Congrès and the beauty of the banks of the Allier.

title: Mariahilfberg near Amberg
short_description: This easy hike leads us on easily accessible paths suitable for children through Amberg's oldest local recreation area. The path through meadows and fields is especially recommended in spring during the blossoming season.
long_description: This easy hike leads us along easily accessible paths (suitable for prams) through Amberg's oldest recreational area. The through meadows and fields is especially recommended in spring during the blossom season. In the second section, the path is very sunny. After the hike, a visit to the mountain church is a good idea. The Mariahilfberg owes its name to the pilgrimage church "Maria Hilf", where our hike begins. This has a long history, which began during the Thirty Years' War around 1633/34. The plague-stricken population of Amberg turned to the Virgin Mary in their distress and vowed to make annual pilgrimages if salvation would come. As a result, a chapel was built in 1641, which was enlarged in 1696 to become today's pilgrimage church in Baroque style. The building was completed in 1702 and consecrated in 1711. Since then, Mariahilfberg has been a popular destination for many pilgrimages. In addition, the church, which is run by the Franciscan Order, is the scene of the annual mountain festival week, which begins on the Feast of the Visitation of Mary on 02 July. Our hike continues past the so-called Kräuterbrünnerl, which used to supply water to the monastery next to the church. On our way we also pass historical devotional places and a wetland biotope maintained by the Bund-Naturschutz.

images.caption: Wonderful hiking experiences around the Mariahilfberg.

title: Ascent to Bostan hut
short_description: Following part of the GRP Tour des Dents Blanches, the climb to the Bostan hut offers fine panoramic views of the Alpine landscape.
long_description:
Departure is from the Plan des Arches parking lot, a convenient and accessible spot that marks the start of this adventure. The trail starts gently through a fir forest, offering a peaceful, shady atmosphere. As you progress, the path winds through alpine meadows dotted with wildflowers.
The climb becomes progressively steeper, with sections offering panoramic views of the surrounding valleys. The first glimpses of the surrounding peaks are encouraging, and each bend reveals new panoramas, reinforcing the sense of wonder and satisfaction. The well-marked trail offers clear signs along the way, making orientation easy even for less experienced hikers.
One of the highlights of the hike is the arrival at Lake Bostan, situated at an altitude of around 1,763 metres. This mountain lake, with its crystal-clear waters and spectacular setting, makes an excellent resting point. It's the ideal place to take a break, picnic and enjoy the scenery before continuing the final climb to the refuge.

title: Enjoyment tour near Weichersbach in the Vorderrhön
short_description: An easy tour across wide fields with a magnificent view of the elevations of the Rhön and the Schwarzenfels castle ruins awaits us.
long_description: We walk in the direction of Neumühle, turn left at Schulwaldstraße and then left into Geisbergstraße. Immediately to the right again, the road leads us in a large curve uphill to a hut with a view of Schwarzenfels Castle (1). Behind it, follow the road and straight ahead along the gravel path until you reach a field path. Here we turn left and immediately right again, then in an arc to the Stephanskuppe nature reserve (2). Follow the road downhill for 200 m and take the second field path to the left and then downhill to Sterbfritz. Following the road "Im Eichfeld" to the left, at the "Feldweg" to the right and straight on via Bahnhofstraße we reach the sports field. On the right we have the opportunity to make a detour to the Kinzigquelle (3). Finally, we walk left to Mottgers to the church (4) and then left along the main road back to the campsite.

title: Walking on the beach at Glowe
short_description: On our Nordic walking tour of Glowe beach, we can see as far as Cape Arkona if the visibility is good. We walk back along the beach promenade.
long_description: We start our Nordic walking tour at the car park on the beach promenade in Glowe and walk to the right along the promenade to Glowe harbour (1). The harbour of Glowe is one of the water walking rest areas on the island of Rügen. At the level of the harbour, we leave the promenade and walk to the beach. We walk along the beach to the left in the direction of Juliusruh. The kilometre-long, white sandy beach of the Schaabe from Glowe to Juliusruh is one of the most beautiful beaches on the island of Rügen. The Schaabe is the natural connection from the Jasmund peninsula to the Wittow peninsula. On the fine sandy beach from Glowe to Juliusruh, it is recommended to walk as close to the water as possible, as the sand there is firmer and thus more suitable for Nordic walking. We walk straight along the Baltic Sea coast and leave the main beach of the popular holiday resort of Glowe. We walk along the beach to the beach access "Rettungsweg 10". Here, with good visibility, we can enjoy the view of Cape Arkona (2). At the beach entrance we turn around and walk back along the beach. At the main beach of Glowe, behind the water rescue tower, we leave the beach on the right and walk onto the beach promenade. On the beach promenade, we walk left back towards the harbour. We walk past Glowe's Kurplatz (3) with several snack stands. Now we continue walking straight ahead and pass a listed building. The so-called beach pavilion (4) was designed by the well-known architect Ulrich Müther in the 1970s. We walk straight ahead along the beach promenade back to Glowe harbour and pass a small fish smokehouse (5). Behind the fish smokehouse we walk straight ahead back to the starting point.

short_description: नई दिल्ली के मालचा राष्ट्रीय वन क्षेत्र में मौजूद एक शानदार हराभरा ट्र ेल मार्ग जिसके आसपास कई सारे बगीचे और उद्यान हैं।

title: The Rhone Route - Switzerland - Great Bicycle Route
short_description: The "Rhone Route" is the name of the VéloRoute that runs through Switzerland along the river of the same name. Together with its French equivalent, the "ViaRhôna", they form EuroVélo 17, a magnificent route linking the imposing mountains of the Swiss Alps to the gentle shores of the Mediterranean.
long_description:
The Rhone Route first crosses the Valais, the sunniest region in Switzerland, with its mountains and pastures. The castles of Sion are then reached, followed by the vineyards and orchards of the lower Rhone valley. The Route then makes a wide arc along the shores of Lake Geneva, via the picturesque terraced vineyards of Lavaux, a World Heritage Site, joining in particular the towns of Montreux, Lausanne and then Geneva.
The Route is long and winding, and the route is very easy to navigate.
This route is about 350km long, and while the sections are adaptable to your desires and abilities, we present it here in 8 stages.

long_description: Located to the south of the village, the Notre-Dame de la Gorge barns offer a view of the entire Val Montjoie to the north, and the Mont-Blanc massif to the northeast, with the main peaks overlooking Les Contamines: the Aiguille de Bionnassay (4,050 m) and the Dômes de Miage (3,370 m).

title: Walking from Bad Krozingen over the vineyard
short_description: The Nordic Walking Tour starts in the spa town of Bad Krozingen at the Vita Classica Therme and takes us around and over the vineyard.
long_description: We start at the entrance to the Vita Classica Therme at the spa gardens in Bad Krozingen. From here we walk past the car park and cross the road. Continue to the right, along the pedestrian and cycle path at the foot of the vineyard. We follow the path until we reach a crossroads and turn left. After about 100 m, a path leads to the left onto the vineyard (1). We follow this for about 1 km until we turn left onto a gravel path. From here we have a great view of the Black Forest. We continue until we reach a T-junction, where we follow the asphalt path to the left. From here we follow the signpost "F1" until we reach a fork, from where a dirt road leads up the slope. Follow this path until you reach a bench with a good panoramic view (2). Behind the bench, turn right to a staircase that leads to a viewing platform (3). On the other side of the platform, walk down a staircase to an asphalt path. Follow this path, keeping to the left, until you reach a single tree. From here, continue straight on back to the spa.

title: Lochbach Trail Extra Tour
short_description: On this half-day tour we experience the Lochbachklamm gorge.
long_description:
We can start in Wallenstein, for example, and hike from there directly into the Lochbachklamm gorge. From Hülsa we hike through rough pastures and enjoy the panorama with Knüll and Knüllköpfchen and the Eisenberg. We continue to the Ferdinand Kersting Hut and then along the forest to the Kanowski Hut. We return to the starting point via the Ebigköpfchen.
In terms of length and degree of exertion, this Hesse extra tour is a half-day hike. The highlight is the small valley of the Lochbach stream, which splashes past moss-covered stones and ferns. Numerous wooden bridges lead the hiker very closely along or over the Lochbach. The first part of the section from Wallenstein to the Kankowski Hut leads along grassy paths through spruce forest. Towards the Kankowski Hut, the beech trees then increase, surrounded in sections by tall grass. Another contrast is the open meadow area north of Hülsa, which offers wide views.

title: Volcano trail
short_description: Grandiose views of the volcanoes of the Eastern Eifel, unique insights into the history of the formation of the fire-breathing mountains - an enjoyable journey into the time of the stone industry.
long_description:
Highlights:
Ettringen Bellberg with fantastic views of the volcanic landscape, Kottenheimer Winfeld mine landscape, "Sieben Stuben" crater caves.
From the Hochsimmerhalle in Ettringen, the first section is a relaxed walk through Ettringen. A narrow meadow path leads up to the summit of the Ettringen Bellberg. A fantastic view of the volcanoes of the Eastern Eifel rewards the ascent. Along the western crater rim, the trail descends to the southern crater breakthrough (a detour to the quarries of the Ettringer Lay is worthwhile here). Via the southern lava flow, the trail reaches the forest of the Kottenheimer Büden. At the foot of the impressive cinder wall are the "Sieben Stuben", small caves where people sought shelter during the Second World War. The route continues up to the south-eastern rim of the crater. Here a magnificent view opens up into the Bellberg quarry and onto the volcanoes Hochsimmer, Bellberg, Sulzbusch and Hochstein. The following passage leads steeply downhill over paved and natural paths into the Kottenheim Winfeld, an idyllic mine landscape with many relics from the times of basalt mining. The trail continues towards Ettringen past the "Junker Schilling" rock monument, then crosses a stream and comes across the Hartborn mineral spring. The trail leads back to the starting point in a relaxed manner.

title: From Novy Liskovec to Brno's reservoir

long_description: The route is headed by the town, partly by the woods. The backs can be used by public transport if you are not accustomed to going further along the route.

title: Alpine enjoyment: Meidpass hike to the Hotel Weisshorn
short_description: Experience majestic views and alpine charm on the Meidpass hike to the Hotel Weisshorn. A breathtaking mountain hike in the Swiss Alps.
long_description:
The hike from Gruben/Meiden over the Meidpass to the Hotel Weisshorn is a breathtaking alpine tour in Switzerland. This route takes you through a picturesque mountain landscape and offers spectacular views of the surrounding peaks and valleys.
The starting point of the hike is the charming village of Gruben or Meiden, depending on which side you start from. From here, you follow the well-marked hiking trails that lead you through alpine meadows and forests as you slowly gain altitude. The Meidpass is the highlight of this tour and offers a great opportunity to admire the majestic mountain scenery.
After crossing the Meidpass, you begin the descent towards the Hotel Weisshorn. The Hotel Weisshorn is a historic mountain hotel perched in a spectacular location high in the Swiss Alps. It is not only a favourite resting place for hikers, but also a wonderful place to enjoy Swiss hospitality and local cuisine.
The hike from Gruben/Meiden over the Meid Pass to the Hotel Weisshorn is an unforgettable experience for nature lovers and mountain enthusiasts. It offers the opportunity to savour the tranquillity of nature and the beauty of the Swiss Alps to the full.

title: Trip to Riesachfälle
short_description: A circular hiking route rich in water and scenery leading to the Riesach Falls in the Styria region near the Salzburg region, Austria.
long_description: A circular walking route leading to the impressive Riesach Falls, rich in views, water and other surprises such as a suspension bridge. Riesach Falls are considered the highest among Styria's waterfalls, with the highest among them falling from a height of more than 70 meters. The walk to the lower waterfall takes about 10 minutes, while the walk to the upper waterfall takes about half an hour (with owners). Depending on personal ability, the route can also be followed one-way, that is, return the same way back (or cut through the small observation bridge and complete a small circular route), but it is recommended to complete the circular route through the suspension bridge that passes over the stream. Since the route includes climbing stairs, it is not accessible to strollers. A great itinerary for those who love wild nature and water.

In summer, Schwarzenbach am Wald also offers numerous opportunities for sports activities. for sporting activities; from mountain biking to swimming and hiking, there is to swimming and hiking, there is something for everyone.

title: Sulzbach and its sinister sides
short_description: On this moderately difficult hike, we learn about the legends, myths and sagas of Sulzbach.
long_description: On this medium-difficulty hike, we learn about the legends, myths and sagas of Sulzbach. Sulzbach im Murrtal is located about 40 km northeast of Stuttgart in the Schwäbisch-Fränkischer Wald Nature Park between the Löwenstein Mountains and the Murrhardt Forest.

title: Aydos Pond - Aydos Forest Nature Walk
short_description: We start from the Aydos Göleti çphase and work our way into the forest
long_description:
Aydos Forest is a must-visit destination for anyone looking for a route to enjoy nature in Istanbul. The unique forest texture, the colourful natural landscapes that exist in every season of the year, the view in the forest and the hill are of special value for every year. The value of merging with nature, silence and peace while walking on the paths in the forest is priceless. 
Aydos Forest offers many routes that you can experience in the centre and throughout the forest for nature and travel enthusiasts. On this route, we start with the view of the gölet and warm up our hearts with the beautiful view of the gölet before the yürüyü. Before we reach the target point of our route, we leave ourselves in the forest among the greenery and plenty of oxygen. Walking along the paths covered with trees on all sides fills us with peace. 
After our walk in the fresh forest air, we return to the lodge. Here we gather some energy and relax with our snacks against the view.
If you like spending time in nature and enjoy walking in the fresh air, Aydos Forest is waiting for you.

title: On the trail of the ore - Reichshof
short_description: This tour takes us along the former mineral resource centres of the Bergisches Land.
long_description: It is assumed that a smelting works existed in Wildberg as early as around 1600, hence the name Wildbergerhütte. For a long time, Wildberg was the centre of ore and silver mining in the region. Our hike takes us on the trail of the ore past Wildberg and other former mineral resource centres of the Bergisches Land.

title: Via ferrata on the Saulakopf in the Rätikon
short_description: The exposed and steep via ferrata on the Saulakopf will delight ambitious via ferrata climbers. The view from the summit reaches far into Switzerland and the Rätikon.
long_description: The via ferrata to the Saulakopf leads exposed and excellently laid out through the east face and over the Südostgrat. The Heinrich Hueter hut is a base point directly on the route. The orientation of the trail is mainly south to south-east. The view from the summit to the Lünersee, to the Zimba and to Switzerland is fantastic. It is advisable to make the ascent to the Heinrich Hueter hut by mountain bike. Alternatively, a hiking bus runs to the alpine inn in the Rellstal valley. To be on the safe side, we do not put on our equipment, including helmet, directly at the foot of the wall, but beforehand because of the risk of falling rocks there! Orientation is easy on the ascent and descent.

images.caption: On the Saula via ferrata with the Zimba in the background.

title: Hike from Ludwigsstadt over the heights of the Franconian Forest
short_description: We are offered magnificent views of the Franconian Forest. In the „Golddorf“ Steinbach an der Haide we encounter a village church with a late medieval fresco cycle.
long_description: Our hiking tour through the Franconian Forest starts in Ludwigsstadt, which not only has a lot to offer in terms of scenery, but is also worthwhile from a cultural point of view. Already at the beginning of the hike on the market square of Ludwigsstadt we have the opportunity to visit the Lutheran St. Michael's Church with its pulpit altar and two important tombs (epithaphs Otto X. of Orlamünde and Christoph of Thüna).

title: Hike through the Vorpommersche Boddenlandschaft in the Zingster Osterwald forest
short_description: The Bodeen landscape is a natural paradise. There are wonderful hiking opportunities along the coast in the Zingster Osterwald near Müggenburg.
long_description:
"Bodden" are small bays cut off from the open sea by (semi-)islands and therefore have a special flora and fauna.
The Western Pomeranian Bodden landscape is a paradise for rare birds. White-tailed eagles and migratory birds find a good resting place here. There are platforms on site from which they can be observed – quietness and Rücaution are required here, because cranes, for example, hüren much better than humans and quickly take flight.
.

title: New cycle path in Limone sul Garda
short_description: On 15 July 2018, the new lakeside cantilevered cycle-pedestrian path built in Limone sul Garda was opened to the public. The Limone cycle-pedestrian path has already been celebrated by national and international media before being officially opened, calling it 'the most beautiful in Europe'.
long_description: The cantilevered section is a unique and extraordinary work, which makes it possible to cycle or walk along a footbridge overhanging the expanse of water of Lake Garda, enjoying a breathtaking view suspended between the lake and the sky. The section recently opened to the public is part of the great 'GARDA BY BIKE' cycle path project, which in the future will make it possible to cycle the entire perimeter of Italy's largest lake, completely safe and separated from vehicular traffic.

images.caption: Garda by BIKE - Ciclopista del lago di Garda
From Limone sul Garda to Riva del Garda by bike (Drone flight)

title: Lovely grove to football
short_description: Short walk around Ricky Ponavka to Reckovice for a football game. The route is short and also suitable for bicycles and darts.
long_description: The short walk around the Lovely grove is also suitable for very small children, the route is also crossing with the draft. Suitable as an afternoon walk. In the half of the route is a small pub where you can buy a retreat, another is at the end of the route on the football playground, where in the seasons of the week the juniors take a game.

title: Les Gorges de Caramy à pied - Tourves
short_description:
À proximité de la ville varoise de Tourves, ce circuit de randonnée vous emmène à la découverte des belles gorges de Caramy.
Translate to English
long_description:
En empruntant le chemin des Grès, l'itinéraire passe par le lieu-dit "La Roquette" avant de rejoindre les ruines du moulin du Caramy, vestige d'un ancien moulin.
La chapelle de Saint-Probace offre ensuite une vue imprenable sur les alentours avant de continuer à monter encore un peu.
Puis, la descente à travers la forêt de Tourves permet de rejoindre les magnifiques gorges de Caramy.
Translate to English

images.caption: randonnée à la Sainte-Baume: Les Gorges de Caramy à pied - Tourves

title: Hiking to the Alloix waterfall
short_description: A cool hike offering a pleasant "water and forest" atmosphere along a path that winds from one side of the torrent to the other, leading to the Grande Cascade (over 43 meters high).
long_description:
Start from the Salle des Fêtes parking lot. Follow the old tramway track to the Torrent de l'Alloix path. Walk up the right bank of the torrent to the first bridge. After a few steep switchbacks, you'll reach the first tufa waterfall, known as Gouille Michel. Continue along the waterfall path, which rises to take you to the Grande Cascade d'Alloix. The climb can be slippery, so take care, especially with children. Continue under the waterfall to the Voie Romaine.
At this crossroads, head back down towards the Chemin de Sainte Marie du Mont and then towards Montalieu. Then return to the Chemin des Cascades and the Place Charbonière, which supplied charcoal to the village forges, before returning to the original route to get back to the starting point.

images.caption: hiking in the Massif de la Chartreuse: Hike by the cascade de l'Alloix

title: scent to the fortress of Starigrad (Fortica) on the more difficult route
short_description: The shorter route to the fortress of Starigrad takes us mostly uphill through the forest and is quite steep. The path is however well marked with a red circle with a white dot.
long_description:
Fortica is not far from the centre of Omis, and this route starts from the bridge over Cetina. The climb starts between the tunnels on the south side of the Cetina River and this route is also the steepest, which is why I recommend approaching it with extra care.
The access itself we didn't find at first: it seems that the ground has just been surrounded by a wire fence (through which there was a cut-out we slipped). There was also a second, dirt road, but there is a "private road" sign on it.
Once we enter the forest we notice the slope of the climb which remains constant all the way to the fortress. The climb to the top takes about 45 minutes, the extremely athletic can probably do it in shorter time.

images.caption: This is where the climb begins
The road, in its difficult variant, to Fortica (descent)

title: Tour of Lake Idro
short_description: One of the most beautiful hikes in the area
long_description:
Nestled in the picturesque Valle Sabbia and dominated by the Little Brescian Dolomites, Lake Idro is the third-largest lake in the province of Brescia and one of the most significant in Lombardy. Less frequented than the better-known Lake Garda and Lake Iseo, it offers an opportunity to explore and relax in a tranquil atmosphere away from the crowds.
The route around the lake is a loop of difficulty E, which can be walked both clockwise and counterclockwise. The route alternates scenic trails, wild beaches and wooden boardwalks with more challenging passages, such as those on paved roads on the western shore and those in the tunnels. Despite some difficulties, the magnificent scenery repays for any effort. Once back at the starting point, you can indulge in a well-deserved dip in the cool waters of the lake.

images.caption: On the shore of Lake Idro

title: From Riedberpass to Besler
short_description: Climb to Besler, one of the most incredible landscapes of the Allgäu with an initially strenuous walk but with an incredible view from the top.
long_description:
One of the most beautiful mountains of the Allgäu with its huge rock wall that enchants everyone and it is possible to take many nice pictures. There is the option of taking the via ferrata to the top but you have to go with equipment and helmet. The signposting is not so good and it is worth looking at the app to not get lost in some stretches.
The ground is made of loose stones and everyone must be careful not to slip. Sturdy boots with grippy soles are worth a try. Finally enjoy taking beautiful 360 degree photos of the whole region.

title: Camlidere Plateau
short_description: This route, the degree of difficulty of which varies according to the season, is centred around the Amlıdere Plateau.
long_description:
Starting from the location of the "Amlıdere Plateau Göleti", this route is an excellent route for those who want to breathe fresh air and carry out a walking activity. 
Leaving the city behind you, when you dive into the roads in the forest, you are greeted by lush green trees and clean air. You can walk through the trees and find peace and tranquillity with silence. You become one with nature and enjoy the nature in peace.
There are many paths in the forest where you can continue the route on the way back, but in order not to make the dönünüşüon more difficult, this route allows you to go back on the same road without going too far.
As tempting as snowy landscapes and winter nature photos are, the route can be extra challenging in winter. For this reason, it is recommended to do the route when the weather conditions are more favourable.

title: Eichert-Reutenen circular trail near Heidenheim
short_description: This medium-sized loop in the southwest of Heidenheim leads us on pleasant gravel paths through the Ugen valley.
long_description:
From the Naturtheater car park, we pass the theatre on the right. Follow the Wildparkweg for about 1 km and pass the enclosures with sika deer, wild boar, red deer, fallow deer, etc. After the Hermann rock, we turn right and walk past a pond into the Ugen valley. Our path leads left along the valley floor for about 1 km, then left up the Arphalde to the settlement of Reutenen. We cross the settlement to the north and then turn left into Heerackerweg. We hike back to the starting point via the sports fields, the Albstadion and the Wildpark. Not far away, Hellenstein Castle is worth a visit.
The castle was built between 1130 and 1145 - today it is in ruins. The castle was built between 1595 and 1611 according to designs by Heinrich Schickhardt.

images.caption: Via the Arphalde we reach the settlement of Reutenen.

title: The Riyam-Muttrah Hill Walk, the C38, Muscat, Oman
short_description: Also knowns as the 'C38', this is a classic walk through the hills between Muttrah and Riyam Park
long_description:
Before the coastal road was constructed, residents of 'old' Muscat would journey on foot or donkey through the 'jebel'. This hike takes you between what is now Riyam Park and the edge of the picturesque old commercial district of Muttrah, the home of Oman's best-known souq and the Corniche.
If you like this route, you might also enjoy this other one nearby:
Visiting Cemetery Bay, Muscat, Oman

title: Laufrunde Lofer
short_description:
Abwechslungsreiche Laufrunde von Lofer oder dem Campingplatz Grubhof, größtenteils auf Asphalt und über den Steig entlang der Saalach. Bei Hochwasser oder nach Starkregen NICHT den Steig, sondern den parallel verlaufenden Weg oberhalb nutzen. Den Steig nutzen tagsüber viele Fußgänger. Daher besser morgens oder abends laufen oder auf den parallelen Weg ausweichen!
Translate to English
long_description:
Diese landschaftlich schöne und flache Laufrunde startet in Lofer und führt zuerst nach Süden durch ein paar ruhige Vororte. Am Campingplatz Grubhof (alternativer Startpunkt) überquert man die Saalach. Nach einem kurzen Stück am Fluss entlang geht es in Scheffsnoth rechts ab nach Au. Es folgt ein toller Abschnitt, immer leicht bergab. In Au geht es wieder rechts. Nachdem man die Antonius Kapelle passiert hat geht es kurz etwas steiler bergab zum Schoberweißbach, der wenige Meter später in die Saalach mündet. Die Saalach überquert man ein zweites Mal über die Autobrücke.
Hier muss man sich nun entscheiden, ob man über den Steig direkt entlang der Saalach oder den paralleln Forstweg läuft. Bei Hochwasser, nach Starkregen oder an Tagen und zu Uhrzeiten, an denen der Steig stark besucht ist, sollte man als Läufer auf den parallel verlaufenden Forstweg ausweichen. Der Steig erfordert als Läufer Trittsicherheit und es geht ein paar mal für wenige Meter steil bergauf und bergab. Unerfahrene Läufer sollten den Steig meiden und den Forstweg nutzen.
Translate to English

title: Peroba Trail
short_description: One of the three open trails of the Parque das Dunas in Natal, has a forest trail and then over the white dunes that lead to a viewpoint with a fantastic view of the sea.
long_description:
The Peroba Trail is one of three trail options in the Parque das Dunas. The trail starts at the "Bosque dos Namorados" (Lovers' Forest) and continues to the belvedere with an incredible landscape. Inside the forest, é possibile know plants and árvores of vegetation çãde;o local, passing through white sand dunes and finally a beautiful viewpoint to take many pictures.
The Parque das Dunas has an area of 1,172 hectares. In all, there are three trails open to the public, which have the help of specialist guides and environmental police. The park was created in 1977 as the first area of preservation of Rio Grande do Norte, the Parque das Dunas is a local heritage and a place that is part of the scenery of those who live or visit the city. Moreover, the park  é considered the largest urban park on dunes in Brazil and extends over a long stretch of the city. Visitors usually see them when crossing the Via Costeira, an important access road to the city, which lies between the Parque das Dunas and the sea.

title: Rando dans le Loiret : le sentier des sources
short_description:
En partant du carrefour de la Résistance, ce circuit pour les amoureux des espaces forestiers et des arbres majestueux est un incontournable du Loiret.
Sur 7 km de chemin, vous passerez à côté de croix témoignant des combats livrés en 1944, de fontaines reflétant le passé royal de la forêt d'Orléans.

title: Bohusleden - Section 20 - Björneröd to Strömstad
short_description: The last stage of Bohusleden leads from Björner to Strømstad.
long_description: The last section of the Bohusleden is also the longest of the entire tour at 23 km. But the terrain becomes flatter and easier to walk. Once again we can enjoy the typical landscape to the full, then we reach our final destination, the town of Strumstad.

title: River Itchen 6km Loop
short_description: A short 6km loop from Winchester town out along the River Itchen and back.

title: Spre Lacul Vulturilor de la Cabana Valea Neagră
short_description:
O alternativă la traseul clasic de urcare spre Lacul Vulturilor din Crasna: lungă, abruptă, dar plină de mici cadouri pe care natura le oferă. 
Translate to English
long_description:
De îndat ce treci râul Buzău, fă-o la dreapta și caută copacii care au marcajul dungă roșie. Lângă Cabana Valea Neagră (cu circuit închis petnru închiriere), vei da de un indicator care anunță 2.5 ore până la Poarta Vânturilor. Nu te lăsa înșelat (ă), căci vei face mai mult de-atât. Adică cel puțin 4 ore.
Aproape în totalitate, traseul e un drum forestier folosit și de MTB-uri, mașini offroad sau ATV-uri pentru urcarea în creastă. Aproape în totalitate, drumul merge prin pădure și-ți dă prilejul să admiri etajarea foioaselor și a coniferelor. În funcție de sezon, poți găsi afine, zmeură, mure, ciuperci comestibile.
Pe la jumătatea drumului, intri într-o poiană largă unde poți face popas sau continua, după plac. Tot cam de pe aici, pădurea de foioase devine una de conifere, mai întunecoasă și mai răcoroasă. Urcușul se domolește și înaintarea e mai ușoară până la ieșirea în platoul alpin.
De la Poarta Vânturilor se fac cam 15-20 de minute până la lac. Și tot aici, dai piept în piept cu vânturi puternice (de unde și numele), indiferent de sezon. Așa că nu-ți lăsa foița de protecție sau polarul acasă!
Translate to English

Urmând marcajul bandă roșie spre lac
Peisaj din poiana aflată aproximativ la jumătatea traseului
Vulturilor Lake and the forest cabin
